​具体​ Agent ​驱动​：turn/step ​状态机​与​请求​构建​

​源码​：packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts（745 ​行​）。​类​ ReactLoopAgent ​是​公开​ Agent ​契约​的​唯一​具体​实现​，​包外​不​可见​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
agent.ts ​把​一个​ session ​驱动​为​连续​的​ turn（​回合​）​与​ step（​步​）：​领取​ inbox ​输入​ → agent/pre-step ​裁决​ → ​组装​与​准入​ → ​构建​请求​ → ​流式​消费​ → ​工具​执行​ → ​回到​ step ​边界​或​关闭​ turn。​文件​分​四层​：

  1. ​模块​级​工具​（requestProposal、abortedCancelCause）：​请求​提议​的​适配器​默认值​剥离​、​取消​原因​的​日志​安全​拷贝​。
  2. ​相位​机​（Phase / setPhase / wakeDriver / kick / whenIdle / runMaintenance）：idle / maintenance / running ​三相​与​唤醒​闩​。
  3. turn/step ​循环​（preStep / turn / step）：​领取​、​瀑布​裁决​、​准入​、​流式​、​工具​分发​、​失败​补记​。
  4. ​请求​构建​（prepareRequest / buildRequest）：agent/request ​瀑布​ + ctx.llm.prepareCall() ​的​能力​绑定​，​以及​ header/context ​记账​与​消息​冻结​。

docs.title: 相位​机​：Phase ​与​唤醒​闩
docs.text:
type Phase =
  | { kind: 'idle'; lastTurn: number }
  | {
    kind: 'maintenance'
    abort: AbortController
    lastTurn: number
    wakeRequested: boolean
  }
  | { kind: 'running'; abort: AbortController; turn: number; step: number; wakeRequested: boolean }

​每个​相位​携带​自己​的​ AbortController；wakeRequested ​是​"​无法​立即​消费​的​唤醒​"​闩​。status getter ​把​ maintenance ​对外​呈现​为​ idle——​公开​状态​只有​ idle | running ​两值​，​维护​任务​不​改变​ agent/status ​的​观察面​。

private wakeDriver(wakeAfterAbort = false): void {
  if (this.phase.kind !== 'idle') {
    // Maintenance and aborted drivers cannot deliver the wake: latch it for
    // replay at convergence. Live drivers claim queued work themselves;
    // disposal never latches, so teardown waits on no model turn.
    const reason = abortedCancelCause(this.phase.abort.signal)
    if (reason?.kind !== 'disposed' && (this.phase.kind === 'maintenance' || wakeAfterAbort)) {
      this.phase.wakeRequested = true
    }
    return
  }
  const driver = Promise.withResolvers<void>()
  this.activityDone = driver.promise
  this.setPhase({
    kind: 'running',
    abort: new AbortController(),
    turn: this.phase.lastTurn,
    step: 0,
    wakeRequested: false,
  })
  this.loopCtx.agents.withInitiator(this, () => this.kick()).then(driver.resolve, driver.reject)
}

​三个​关键点​：

  • ​存活​驱动​不​需要​闩​：​运行​中​的​驱动​会​在​ step ​边界​自己​领取​队列​；​只有​ maintenance ​与​已​取消​的​活动​才​需要​把​唤醒​闩​住​，​收敛​时​重放​。
  • disposal ​永不​闩​：​拆除​不​等待​模型​ turn。
  • initiator scope：​驱动​在​ ctx.agents.withInitiator(this, ...) ​内​运行​，​链路​上​的​ requireInitiator() ​能​做​因果​归因​。
async whenIdle(): Promise<void> {
  let activity: Promise<void>
  do {
    await (activity = this.activityDone)
  } while (activity !== this.activityDone)
}

whenIdle() ​用​"​等待​后​再​核对​"​循环​跟随​被​唤醒​输入​启动​的​替代​活动​：await ​期间​新​驱动​替换​了​ activityDone，​就​继续​等​下​一个​。

docs.title: 投递​三​别名​与​取消
docs.text:
send(message: UserMessage, target: InboxTarget, wakeup: boolean): void {
  // Waking input cannot join an aborted activity, so it starts the next turn.
  // Captured before the insertion so a reentrant cancel from a splice observer cannot reclassify it.
  const wakingAfterAbort = wakeup && this.phase.kind !== 'idle' && this.phase.abort.signal.aborted
  const resolvedTarget = wakingAfterAbort ? 'next-turn' : target
  this.inbox.splice(resolvedTarget, Infinity, 0, [message])
  if (wakeup) this.wakeDriver(wakingAfterAbort)
}

followup(input: UserMessage): void {
  this.send(input, 'next-turn', true)
}

steer(input: UserMessage): void {
  this.send(input, 'next-step', true)
}

inject(input: UserMessage): void {
  this.send(input, 'next-step', false)
}

followup / steer / inject ​是​ send ​的​固定​预设​：turn ​队列​唤醒​、step ​边界​唤醒​、step ​边界​不​唤醒​。agent.inject() ​的​语义​由此​落地​：​注入​的​模型​可见​上下文​被​追加​到​ next-step ​队列​但​不​唤醒​驱动​——​空闲​驱动​保持​ pending，​运行​驱动​在​最近​的​ step ​边界​领取​；​领到​的​消息​ source.kind === 'runtime-context'，​在​ step() ​中会​被​"​原位​替换​"​为​新鲜​快照​（​见下文​准入​一节​）。

wakingAfterAbort ​在​插入​之前​捕获​：inbox ​的​ splice ​观察者​可能​重​入​ cancel()，​先​捕获​防​改写​分类​。

cancel(cause: AgentCancelCause, options: CancelOptions = {}): void {
  if (!options.keepInbox) {
    this.inbox.clear()
    if (this.phase.kind !== 'idle') this.phase.wakeRequested = false
  }
  if (this.phase.kind !== 'idle') this.phase.abort.abort(cause)
}

​无​活动​时​ cancel() ​是​ no-op（​除​清空​ inbox），​不会​武装​未来​的​工作​——​不​预先​取消​下​一​ turn。​空闲​相位​下​ keepInbox ​未设​时​仍会​清空​两个​待处理​列表​。

abortedCancelCause() ​是​取消​原因​进入​日志​前​的​守门​：

function abortedCancelCause(signal: AbortSignal): AgentCancelCause | undefined {
  if (!signal.aborted) return undefined
  // `cancel()` ​是​该​循环​拥有​的​信号​唯一​的​ abort ​发起者​。
  const cause = signal.reason as AgentCancelCause
  switch (cause.kind) {
    case 'user':
    case 'parent':
    case 'disposed':
      return { kind: cause.kind }
    case 'hook':
      return { kind: 'hook', reason: cause.reason }
    /* v8 ignore next -- cancel accepts the closed AgentCancelCause union */
    default:
      return assertNever(cause)
  }
}

​只​拷贝​ turn/end ​会​记录​的​字​段​。​进程​内​的​ AbortSignal.reason ​仍​是​调用者​原​对象​——Node ​的​ fetch ​会往​上​挂​ stack，​而​ Session.append ​拒绝​或​无法​序列化​这种​附加​数据​。​拷贝​把​痕迹​挡​在​日志​外​，​同时​保证​收尾​追加​可​提交​。

docs.title: preStep：​领取​与​ accept/rewrite/reject ​裁决
docs.text:
private async preStep(target: InboxTarget, position: { turn: number; step: number }): Promise<PreparedStep> {
  if (this.phase.kind !== 'running') throw new Error(`agent "${this.id}": pre-step outside running phase`)
  const signal = this.phase.abort.signal
  const claimed = this.inbox.claim(target, position.turn)
  const selection = this.model.current()
  if (selection === undefined) {
    throw new Error(`agent "${this.id}" has no provider/model: set AgentOptions.provider and AgentOptions.model or record a model selection`)
  }
  const toolSet = await this.loopCtx.tools.resolve({ agent: this, modelSelection: selection, signal })
  try {
    const assembly = await this.loopCtx.systemPrompt.assemble({ ...assembleContextFor(this, signal), modelSelection: selection, toolSet })
    signal.throwIfAborted()
    const decision = await this.dispatch.waterfall(
      'agent/pre-step', { messages: claimed, ...position, signal, modelSelection: selection },
      (): Promise<PreStepDecision> => {
        const sections = renderContextSections(assembly)
        const context = this.runtimeContext.project(joinContextSections(sections), sections)
        return Promise.resolve<PreStepDecision>({
          kind: 'enter',
          messages: context === undefined ? claimed : [...claimed, context],
        })
      },
    )
    signal.throwIfAborted()
    if (decision.kind === 'reject') {
      toolSet.dispose()
      return decision
    }
    return { ...decision, assembly, selection, toolSet }
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    toolSet.dispose()
    throw error
  }
}

​执行​顺序​是​固定​的​：​先​ claim，​再​准备​。claim ​是​"​纯​删除​ splice + ​逐条​ agent/inbox/claimed ​通知​"（​见​ inbox.md），​被​改写​掉​的​消息​不会​回流​队列​。​随后​解析​工具集​与​ prompt ​装配​——assembleContextFor()（packages/core/agent/src/dispatch.ts）​同时​带​ agent ​与​ scope: agent，agent ​局部​的​ prompt/tool ​贡献​不会​漏掉​。

agent/pre-step ​是​请求​派​生前​唯一​的​瀑布​监听​链​，​三种​决策​：

​决策​ ​效果​ ​调用​ next()（​默认​终点​） accept：​进入​ claimed（​可能​追加​运行​时​上下文​候选​）。​不​设置​ startsRequestSeries——​只有​监听器​能​声明​新​系列​ ​返回​ { kind: 'enter', messages, startsRequestSeries? } rewrite：​用​返回​的​批次​进入​ step；​被​省略​的​ claimed ​消息​保持​移除​；claim ​之后​插入​的​输入​留在​队列​ ​返回​ { kind: 'reject' } reject：​不​开​ step，turn ​以​ { kind: 'blocked' } ​关闭​；​已​ claim ​的​消息​停​在​ claimed ​状态​，​既​不​丢弃​也​不​重新​提交​

reject ​与​异常​路径​都​ toolSet.dispose()——​准入​（admission）​在​ step ​的​工具​批次​结算​或​不开​ step ​时​关闭​。

docs.title: turn()：turn ​边界​与​失败​补记
docs.text:
private async turn(): Promise<boolean> {
  // ...
  const { signal } = phase.abort
  signal.throwIfAborted()
  const turn = phase.turn + 1
  try {
    this.session.append('turn/start', { turn })
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    this.throwError(error)
  }
  phase.turn = turn
  let turnEnds: TurnEndReason | null = null
  let target: InboxTarget = 'next-turn'

turn ​编号​来自​ phase.turn + 1，​而​ phase.turn ​初始值​是​构造​时​传入​的​ lastTurn——​由​ AgentLoop ​经​ ctx.agents.turnBoundaryOf(session).lastTurn ​读出​，​因此​恢复​后​ turn ​计数​延续​持久​化​历史​，​不会​从​ 0 ​重​来​。

step ​循环​里​最​有​信息量​的​一段​是​失败​补记​：

try {
  signal.throwIfAborted()
  this.session.append('step/start', { turn, step })
  phase.step = step
  const toolRecovery = new ToolCallRecovery()
  const stopRecovery = this.ctx.on('session/event', (session, event) => {
    if (session === this.session) toolRecovery.observe(event)
  })
  try {
    // max-tokens is sticky: once any step hits the ceiling, later steps
    // that complete normally must not downgrade the turn outcome.
    const stepEnd = await this.step(decision)
    if (turnEnds === null || turnEnds.kind !== 'max-tokens') turnEnds = stepEnd
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    try {
      for (const event of toolRecovery.results()) {
        this.session.append('tool/result', event.data, {
          surfaceOp: 'append',
          ...event.sourceEventSeqs === undefined ? {} : { sourceEventSeqs: event.sourceEventSeqs },
        })
      }
    } catch (recoveryError: unknown) {
      throw new AggregateError([error, recoveryError], 'Step failed and its pending tool results could not be recorded', { cause: error })
    }
    throw error
  } finally {
    stopRecovery()
    this.session.append('step/end', { turn, step })
  }
} finally {
  // Admission closes once the step's tool batch settles or no step opens.
  decision.toolSet.dispose()
}

ToolCallRecovery（packages/core/session/src/repair.ts）​观察​本​ session ​的​已​提交​事件​，​跟踪​未​应答​的​ assistant tool call。step ​抛错​时​在​ step/end ​之前​补记​合成​ tool/result：​已​记录​ tool/call ​的​得​ TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN（"Its outcome is unknown."），​连​开始​记录​都​没有​的​得​ TOOL_NOT_STARTED。​补记​失败​升级​为​ AggregateError（​原始​错误​ + ​恢复​错误​）——​原始​失败​保持​为​ cause。

turn ​收尾​与续​转​：

if (turnEnds && this.inbox.nextStep.length === 0) {
  await this.dispatch.serial('agent/turn-stopping', { turn, signal })
  signal.throwIfAborted()
}
if (turnEnds && this.inbox.nextStep.length === 0) break
target = 'next-step'

turn ​只​在​"step ​有​了​结论​（completed / max-tokens / blocked）​且​ next-step ​已空​"​后​运行​ serial ​的​ agent/turn-stopping——​监听器​通过​ agent.steer(...) ​反对​即​注入​下​一步​输入​，​机器​重读​ inbox，​数据​决定​是否​继续​。​异常​路径​把​取消​原因​转​成​ { kind: 'aborted', reason: cause }，​普通​错误​转​成​ LlmError.failure ​或​ errorChain ​文本​（ToolActivationError ​保留​其​ code，​其余​ UNKNOWN），​经​ throwError() ​先发​ agent/error ​再重​抛​。finally ​无条件​追加​ turn/end。

if (!this.inbox.hasPending) return false
phase.abort = new AbortController()
// A fresh controller makes a latch set on the old one stale: the live driver claims the queue itself.
phase.wakeRequested = false
phase.step = 0
return true

​换​新​ AbortController ​是​精妙​的​一笔​：​旧​信号​上​挂​起​的​唤醒​闩​随之​失效​，​存活​驱动​自己​领取​队列​，​不再​需要​重​放​。

​首步​空批​的​特例​（​就​在​循环​开头​）：

if (turnEnds && decision.messages.length === 0) break
// A removed waking message or an enter decision rewritten to empty
// still owns the initial turn boundary, but it spends no model call.
if (phase.step === 0 && decision.messages.length === 0) {
  turnEnds = { kind: 'completed' }
  return false
}

​被​移除​的​唤醒​消息​或​被​改写​为空​的​ enter ​决策​仍​拥有​ turn ​边界​（turn/start ​已​提交​），​但​不花​模型​调用​。

docs.title: step()：​准入​时序​与​流式​消费
docs.text:
step() ​是​整个​文件​的​核心​。​先​看准​入段​：

const { assembly } = decision
const renderedPrompt = renderPrompt(assembly)
let firstAttempt = true
while (true) {
  const { config, preparedCall } = await this.prepareRequest(turn, step, decision.selection, signal)
  const currentContext = this.loopCtx.systemPrompt.refreshContext(assembly, {
    ...assembleContextFor(this, signal), modelSelection: decision.selection,
  })
  const sections = renderContextSections(currentContext)
  const context = this.runtimeContext.project(joinContextSections(sections), sections)
  signal.throwIfAborted()
  const startsRequestSeries = firstAttempt && decision.startsRequestSeries === true
  const commits = this.systemPrompt.project(renderedPrompt, {
    inHistory: preparedCall?.systemPromptUpdate === 'in-history',
    startsSeries: startsRequestSeries
      || this.requestSurfaceGeneration !== this.session.surface.contentGeneration
      || (preparedCall?.toolUpdate === undefined && this.toolsChanged(assembly.tools)),
  })
  for (const { message, intent } of commits) {
    this.session.append('system/message', { turn, step, message }, intent)
  }

​取消​承诺​的​落点​就​在​这​一行​ signal.throwIfAborted()：agent/request ​瀑布​与​ refreshContext ​都​在​它​之前​，​两个​异步​阶段​都​看不到​待​提交​的​ system prompt ​或​已​接受​的​ user ​消息​；​取消​发生​在​其间​时​ system ​与​ user ​均​不​提交​。throwIfAborted() ​之后​到​ user ​准入​之间​没有​ await，​这​一段​提交​在​ JS ​语义上​是​原子​的​。

startsRequestSeries ​三个​来源​在​ startsSeries ​参数​里​汇聚​：

  1. pre-step ​决策​声明​的​ decision.startsRequestSeries === true（​仅​首次​尝试​生效​）；
  2. surface ​替换​或​图像​卸载​让​ session.surface.contentGeneration ​发生变化​；
  3. ​装配​出​的​工具​ schema ​有变​，​而​ prepared route ​不​支持​ toolUpdate。

startsRequestSeries ​与​ request/header ​的​联动​在​ buildRequest() ​里​落地​（​见​下节​）：​新​系列​让​ header ​以​ series ​记录​或​携带​ startsSeries: true，​且​ system prompt ​调和​会​重新​基线​化​。

user ​准入​段​：

let contextAdmitted = false
if (firstAttempt) {
  for (const message of decision.messages) {
    if (message.source.kind === 'runtime-context') {
      if (context !== undefined && !contextAdmitted) {
        this.session.append('user/message', context, { surfaceOp: 'append' })
        contextAdmitted = true
      }
    } else {
      this.session.append('user/message', message, { surfaceOp: 'append' })
    }
  }
}
if (context !== undefined && !contextAdmitted) {
  this.session.append('user/message', context, { surfaceOp: 'append' })
}
firstAttempt = false

​三条​规则​：

  • user ​消息​只​在​首次​尝试​提交​：​重试​复用​同​一份​装配​，​不​重复​准入​。
  • ​运行​时​上下文​原位​替换​：claim ​到​的​ runtime-context ​消息​（agent.inject() ​的​产物​）​不​直接​提交​，​而是​在​其​队列​位置​上​换成​新鲜​的​ context ​候选​；​候选​为​ undefined（​快照​未​变​）​时​连声​称​的​消息​也​不​重复​提交​。
  • ​重试​恢复​运行​时​上下文​：​循环​尾部​的​兜底​ if (context !== undefined && !contextAdmitted) ​每次​迭代​都​会​执行​——​重试​间​快照​变化​会补​一条​新​快照​。

​流式​段​（​骨架​）：

const request = this.buildRequest(config, preparedCall, assembly.tools, { turn, step }, startsRequestSeries, signal)
const live = new AssistantStreamAttempt(
  this.session.id,
  ++this.assistantAttemptCounter,
  () => ++this.assistantStreamRevision,
  turn,
  step,
  (frame) => { this.dispatch.emit('agent/assistant-stream', { frame }) },
)
let started = false
try {
  const stream = preparedCall?.stream(request) ?? this.loopCtx.llm.stream(request)
  signal.throwIfAborted()
  live.start()
  started = true
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    signal.throwIfAborted()
    live.push(chunk)
  }
  signal.throwIfAborted()
} catch (error: unknown) {
  if (!started) throw error
  try {
    if (signal.aborted) {
      const content = live.interruptedBlocks()
      if (content.length > 0) {
        live.settle('assistant/message', () => this.session.append('assistant/message', {
          turn,
          step,
          message: createAssistantMessage({
            content,
            source: { provider: request.provider, model: request.model, /* replayState? */ },
          }),
          interrupted: true,
          ...live.usage === undefined ? {} : { usage: live.usage },
          stream: live.stream,
        }, { surfaceOp: 'append' }).seq)
      } else {
        live.settle('assistant/attempt', () => this.session.append('assistant/attempt', { turn, step, stream: live.stream }).seq)
      }
    } else {
      live.settle('assistant/attempt', () => this.session.append('assistant/attempt', { turn, step, stream: live.stream }).seq)
    }
  } catch (settlementError: unknown) {
    throw new AggregateError([error, settlementError], 'Assistant stream failed and its durable settlement was rejected', { cause: error })
  }
  throw error
}

​绑定​的​ preparedCall ​优先​于​ ctx.llm.stream()——​同一​ adapter ​贯穿​解析​、header ​记账​与​分发​。​取消​时​已​交付​前缀​不​丢​：interruptedBlocks() ​非空​则​提交​ interrupted: true ​的​ assistant/message ​携带​用户​看到​的​文本​，​下​一次​请求​就​包含​它​；​可见​前缀​为空​（​或​错误​流​）​落​ assistant/attempt。

​终结​处理​与​重试​：

const finish = live.finish
if (finish.kind === 'error' || finish.kind === 'aborted') {
  live.settle('assistant/attempt', () => this.session.append('assistant/attempt', { turn, step, stream: live.stream }).seq)
  const action = await this.dispatch.waterfall(
    'agent/request-error', { turn, step, provider: request.provider, failure: finish.failure, retryPolicy: preparedCall?.retryPolicy, signal },
    () => Promise.resolve<RequestErrorAction>(undefined),
  )
  signal.throwIfAborted()
  if (action?.kind !== 'retry') {
    throw new LlmError(finish.failure.message, finish.failure.code, finish.failure)
  }
  continue
}

​最终​ adapter ​选择​、​分发​与​迭代​失败​以​终结​ finish ​到达​，​进入​ agent/request-error ​瀑布​：​持有​恢复​的​监听器​返回​ { kind: 'retry' } ​且​不​调用​ next()，​默认​ undefined ​保持​失败​终结​。continue ​回到​循环​头​——​同​一份​装配​直接​重试​，​不重​跑​ agent/pre-step ​或​ user ​准入​（​不​变量​"​重试​不​重复​组装​"）。

​成功​路径​提交​ assistant/message ​后处理​工具​调用​：

const toolCalls = message.content.filter(block => block.type === 'tool-call')
if (toolCalls.length === 0) return { kind: 'completed' }
const maxParallelToolCalls = this.loopCtx.agentLoop.config.maxParallelToolCalls.get()
try {
  const result = await this.loopCtx.tools.execute({
    calls: toolCalls, signal, agent: this, log: { turn, step },
    maxParallelToolCalls, toolSet: decision.toolSet,
  })
  for (const context of result.additionalContexts) {
    this.inbox.splice('next-step', this.inbox.nextStep.length, 0, [context])
  }
  return result.concluded ? { kind: 'completed' } : null
} catch (error: unknown) {
  if (!(error instanceof ToolBatchExecutionError)) throw error
  for (const context of error.partial.additionalContexts) {
    this.inbox.splice('next-step', this.inbox.nextStep.length, 0, [context])
  }
  throw error.cause
}

​循环​把​完整​原始​批次​交给​ ctx.tools.execute()，​并​传入​当前​ volatile ​配置​ maxParallelToolCalls（​覆盖​执行器​自身​配置​）​与​ step ​准入​解析​的​ toolSet。​返回​ null ​表示​工具​延续​：​外层​ turn ​循环​把​ target ​切​到​ next-step，​领取​ steering / additionalContexts / inject ​的​输入​开​下​一步​。ToolBatchExecutionError ​拆包​：​先落​部分​ additionalContexts，​再​抛​ cause。

docs.title: prepareRequest：agent/request ​瀑布​与​ prepareCall
docs.text:
private async prepareRequest(
  turn: number,
  step: number,
  selection: Readonly<ModelSelection>,
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<{ config: LlmCallConfig; preparedCall?: PreparedLlmCall }> {
  const { session } = this

  // A loop instance seeds output controls from its options until it logs its
  // own header; later steps re-resolve marked defaults.
  const maxTokens = this.options.maxTokens
  const persisted: Partial<LlmCallConfig> = this.requestHeaderLogged
    ? requestProposal(session.requestHeader()!)
    : maxTokens === undefined ? {} : { maxTokens }
  const { provider: _provider, model: _model, reasoningEffort: _effort, ...controls } = persisted
  const seedConfig = deepFreeze(structuredClone({ ...controls, ...selection }))
  const proposedConfig = await this.dispatch.waterfall(
    'agent/request', { turn, step, signal },
    () => Promise.resolve(seedConfig),
  )

​种子​配置​的​组装​规则​：​实例​记录​过​自己​的​ header ​之后​，​从​ session.requestHeader() ​折叠​持久​控制​并用​ requestProposal() ​剥离​ adapter ​标记​的​默认​字​段​；​此前​则​从​ AgentOptions.maxTokens ​播种​。route ​字​段​（provider/model/effort）​始终​来自​ step ​准备​时​捕获​的​ selection——agent/pre-step.modelSelection ​与​ AssembleContext.modelSelection ​携带​同​一份​捕获​，​贯穿​本​ step ​的​全部​重试​。

​瀑布​之后​是​路线​守卫​：

if (proposedConfig.provider !== selection.provider || proposedConfig.model !== selection.model) {
  throw new Error(`agent "${this.id}": agent/request proposed "${proposedConfig.provider}/${proposedConfig.model}" after step preparation fixed "${selection.provider}/${selection.model}"; use agent.model.select() before step preparation`)
}
if (proposedConfig.reasoningEffort !== selection.reasoningEffort) {
  throw new Error(`agent "${this.id}": agent/request proposed reasoning effort "${proposedConfig.reasoningEffort ?? 'adapter default'}" after step preparation fixed "${selection.reasoningEffort ?? 'adapter default'}"; use agent.model.select() before step preparation`)
}

​已弃​用​的​ agent/request ​钩子​可以​改​采样​等​控制​，​但换​ provider/model/effort ​一律​拒绝​——route ​变更​必须​走​ agent.model.select() ​且​在​ step ​准备​之前​。​之后​ ctx.llm.prepareCall() ​校验​ adapter ​拥有​的​字​段​、​在​活跃​ turn ​信号​下​解析​ effort ​与​输出​ token ​默认值​：

try {
  preparedCall = await this.loopCtx.llm.prepareCall(proposedConfig, signal)
  config = preparedCall.config
} catch (error: unknown) {
  // Middleware may serve an unregistered route; terminal dispatch still requires an adapter.
  if (!(error instanceof LlmError) || error.code !== 'NO_ADAPTER') throw error
  config = proposedConfig
}

NO_ADAPTER ​不​立即​失败​：​中间件​可能​自己​服务​未注册​路线​，preparedCall ​缺席​，​终结​分发​仍​要求​ adapter ​存在​（​否则​照旧​ NO_ADAPTER ​失败​）。​循环​在​解析​、request/header ​记账​与​分发​之间​保留​同一个​ prepared adapter。

docs.title: buildRequest：header ​记账​、series ​标记​与​请求​冻结
docs.text:
const header = canonicalHeader({
  config,
  ...preparedCall === undefined ? {} : { adapterDefaults: preparedCall.adapterDefaults },
  ...tools.length > 0 ? { tools } : {},
})
const baseline = this.session.requestHeader()
const startsSeries = startsRequestSeries
  || this.requestSurfaceGeneration !== surfaceGeneration
let headerSeq: SessionSeq | undefined
if (!this.requestHeaderLogged) {
  // Compaction during the first resumed pre-step must still mark a new series.
  headerSeq = this.session.append('request/header', {
    header,
    reason: baseline === undefined ? 'initial' : 'resume',
    ...startsSeries ? { startsSeries: true } : {},
  }).seq
  this.requestHeaderLogged = true
} else if (baseline === undefined || !headerEquals(baseline, header)) {
  headerSeq = this.session.append('request/header', {
    header,
    reason: 'change',
    ...startsSeries ? { startsSeries: true } : {},
  }).seq
} else if (startsSeries) {
  this.session.append('request/header', { header, reason: 'series' })
}

request/header ​的​四种​记录​时机​：

​情形​ reason ​说明​ ​本​实例​首​请求​ initial（​日志​无​ header）​或​ resume（​有​） ​恢复​的​会​话​在​此续​上​ header ​链​；​恢复​期间​ pre-step ​里​发生​的​ compaction ​仍​会标​新​系列​ header ​与​基线​不​等​ change config ​或​ tools ​变化​（prompt ​不​属于​ header） header ​相等​但​开新​系列​ series startsRequestSeries ​声明​或​ surface generation ​变化​ ​相同​且​不开​系列​ ​不​记录​ ​未变​的​ step、​重试​、​同​系列​后续​ turn ​继承​最新​ header

startsRequestSeries ​就​在​这里​落​进​ request/header：​以​ startsSeries: true ​标记​或​独立​的​ series ​记录​，​请求​系列​由此​定界​。

header ​之后​还有​两条​记账​：​工具​增删​生成​一条​ developer/message（​与​ headerSeq ​一起​提交​，​与​模型​能力​无关​——​只​比较​前后​ header ​的​工具​名​集合​）；request/context（provider、model、contextWindow、route ​的​ systemPromptUpdate ​模式​）​仅​在​四元组​相对​上​一​快照​任一​不​同时​追加​。

​最后​是​派生​与​冻结​：

// canonicalHeader is shallow; append logs a detached snapshot, not these local values.
deepFreeze(header)
const boundaryMessages = session.deriveMessages()
for (const message of boundaryMessages) {
  if (this.frozenMessages.has(message)) continue
  deepFreeze(message)
  this.frozenMessages.add(message)
}
Object.freeze(boundaryMessages)
const request = markAgentLoopRequest(Object.freeze({
  ...header.config,
  messages: boundaryMessages,
  toolHistory: session.toolHistory(),
  ...header.tools !== undefined ? { tools: header.tools } : {},
  sessionId: this.session.id,
  signal,
}))
return request

​冻结​的​三个​精确​边界​：

  • ​每条​派生​消息​身份​在​它​的​首个​请求​上深​冻结​，WeakSet ​保证​弱​引用​不​滞留​被​替换​的​历史​；​冻结​证明​只​在​本​ agent ​内​复用​，​恢复​的​消息​保持​原​身份​。
  • ​冻结​请求​自身​三件套​：​本地​ canonical header、​新​消息​数组​（Object.freeze(boundaryMessages)）、​信封​——​取消​信号​保持​活跃​（signal ​原样​进入​请求​）。
  • ​请求​不​携带​ system ​字​段​：​请求​ = header.config + deriveMessages() + header.tools，system prompt ​以​ system/message ​节点​出现​在​派生​历史​里​。

markAgentLoopRequest()（packages/llm/llm/src/call-config.ts）​打​上​"​来自​ agent loop ​的​请求​"​标记​，​供​ LLM ​层​识别​调用​来源​。

docs.title: 小结
docs.text: agent.ts ​的​全部​复杂性​都​围绕​一条​纪律​展开​：​请求​从​日志​派生​，​模型​可见​之前​先落​日志​，​落​日志​之前​先过​取消​点​。claim ​与​裁决​在​ turn/step ​边界​先行​；prepareRequest ​把​ route ​捕获​、agent/request ​瀑布​与​ adapter ​能力​绑定​成一​回事​；​准入​段​在​ throwIfAborted() ​之后​原子​地​提交​ system（​三种​路由​）​与​ user（​仅​首次​、​运行​时​上下文​原位​替换​）；buildRequest ​记​ header/context、​标​ series、​冻结​派生​请求​；​流式​消费​先​结算​持久​事件​再发​终结​帧​。​取消​、​重试​、​失败​补记​都​不是​特例​，​而是​同一​不​变量​集合​在​不同​边界​的​投影​。

docs.title: assistant-stream.ts — ​流式​帧​协议
docs.text:
​单次​模型​尝试​的​帧​发布​与​持久​流​累积​

​源码​：packages/core/agent-loop/src/assistant-stream.ts（140 ​行​）。​导出​ AssistantStreamAttempt。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
​每次​模型​请求​（attempt）​需要​一个​对象​同时​做​三件​事​：

  1. ​进程​内​发布​：​把​ start → chunk → end ​三类​ AssistantStreamFrame ​发到​ agent/assistant-stream（emit，agent-scoped），​供​ UI ​实时​渲染​；
  2. ​持久​累积​：​把​流​ chunk ​压缩成​一份​可​写入​日志​的​ AssistantStreamRecord ​快照​，​并​把​文本​ delta ​组装​成​规范​ ContentBlock[]；
  3. ​结算​协议​：​终结​ end ​帧​只能​在​匹配​的​持久​事件​（assistant/message ​或​ assistant/attempt）​提交​之后​发出​。

AssistantStreamAttempt ​把​三件​事​折进​一个​实例​，​生命周期​恰好​覆盖​一次​模型​尝试​：agent.ts ​的​ step() ​为​每次​尝试​构造​它​，live.start() → live.push(chunk) → live.settle(...) ​或​ live.abandon()。

​帧​协议​（​类型​声明​于​ packages/core/agent/src/types.ts）：

  • start：attemptId + revision + turn/step，​在​首个​交付​ chunk ​之前​发布​；
  • chunk：index（​尝试​内​稠密​零基​位置​）+ time + chunk（StreamChunk）；
  • end：index（​本​尝试​的​ chunk ​帧​数​）+ outcome——committed（​带​ eventType ​与​持久​ seq）​或​ abandoned（​无​持久​事件​可​提交​时​的​活体​放弃​）。

docs.title: 构造​与​身份
docs.text:
/** Folds one model attempt into one compact stream plus ordered transient frames. */
export class AssistantStreamAttempt {
  private readonly accumulator = new AssistantStreamAccumulator()
  private readonly assembler = new BlockAssembler()
  private index = 0
  private terminal = false
  /** Attempt identity unique within this Agent lifecycle. */
  readonly attemptId: LlmAttemptId

  constructor(
    sessionId: SessionId,
    attempt: number,
    private readonly nextRevision: () => number,
    readonly turn: number,
    readonly step: number,
    private readonly emit: (frame: AssistantStreamFrame) => void,
  ) {
    this.attemptId = LlmAttemptId(`${sessionId}:${attempt}`)
  }
  • attemptId = `${sessionId}:${attempt}`，​在​单个​ Agent ​生命周期​内​唯一​；attempt ​是​ attached-Session ​局部​计数器​（agent.ts ​的​ assistantAttemptCounter）。
  • nextRevision ​由​调用​方​注入​（() => ++this.assistantStreamRevision）：revision ​是​ attached-Session ​进程​内​单调​号​，​替换​重启​（resume）​后​从​ 1 ​重新​开始​。​注入​而​不是​自持​，​让​"​每帧​一个​ revision"​的​分配​集中​在​一处​。
  • ​两个​内部​累积​器​分工​：AssistantStreamAccumulator（@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm）​做​持久​压缩​——​决定​哪些​ chunk ​进入​最终​写入​日志​的​流​记录​；BlockAssembler ​做​消息​组装​——​从同​一批​ chunk ​产出​规范​内容​块​。

docs.title: start / push：​发布​与​快照​一次​成型
docs.text:
/** Publish the opening marker before the first delivered chunk. */
start(): void {
  this.emit({
    type: 'start',
    attemptId: this.attemptId,
    revision: this.nextRevision(),
    turn: this.turn,
    step: this.step,
  })
}

/** Snapshot one chunk once, then feed durable compaction, assembly, and live publication. */
push(chunk: StreamChunk): void {
  const timed = this.accumulator.push({ time: Date.now(), chunk })
  this.assembler.push(timed.chunk)
  this.emit({
    type: 'chunk',
    attemptId: this.attemptId,
    revision: this.nextRevision(),
    index: this.index++,
    time: timed.time,
    chunk: timed.chunk,
  })
}

push() ​是​唯一​可能​重复​消费​ chunk ​的​地方​，​所以​它​把​"​打​时间​戳​"​收敛​为​一次​：accumulator.push() ​返回​带​时间​的​ chunk（​时间​戳​被​持久​流​记录​复用​），​随后​同一​对象​喂给​ assembler ​与​ emit——​持久​压缩​、​消息​组装​、​实时​发布​三个​消费者​共享​同​一份​快照​，​无​二次​拷贝​。

agent.ts ​的​调用​侧​在​每轮​迭代​之间​检查​取消​信号​：

for await (const chunk of stream) {
  signal.throwIfAborted()
  live.push(chunk)
}

​取消​后​循环​终止​，push ​不再​被​调用​——​已​ push ​的​ chunk ​都​已​发布​且​已​进入​累积​器​。

docs.title: settle：​持久​事件​先行​，​终结​帧​随后
docs.text:
/**
 * Publish terminal settlement after the matching durable event commits.
 * @param eventType - durable settlement type.
 * @param append - synchronous durable append returning its committed seq.
 */
settle(
  eventType: 'assistant/message' | 'assistant/attempt',
  append: () => SessionSeq,
): void {
  let seq: SessionSeq
  try {
    seq = append()
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    this.abandon()
    throw error
  }
  this.terminal = true
  this.emit({
    type: 'end',
    attemptId: this.attemptId,
    revision: this.nextRevision(),
    index: this.index,
    outcome: { kind: 'committed', eventType, seq },
  })
}

/** Publish abandonment when no durable attempt event can be committed. */
abandon(): void {
  this.terminal = true
  this.emit({
    type: 'end',
    attemptId: this.attemptId,
    revision: this.nextRevision(),
    index: this.index,
    outcome: { kind: 'abandoned' },
  })
}

settle() ​的​顺序​就是​不​变量​"​模型​可见​ ⟺ ​已​记录​"​在​流​协议​上​的​落点​：​先​ append() ​拿到​持久​ seq，​再发​ end ​帧​——​帧​的​消费者​看到​ committed ​时​，​持久​事件​已经​在​日志​里​。​追加​失败​则​转​ abandon() ​再重​抛​：agent.ts ​的​外层​ catch ​里​ if (!live.ended) live.abandon() ​由此​不再​触发​第二次​（terminal ​已置位​）。

abandon() ​用于​"​活体​放弃​"：​装配​或​提交​失败​、​工具​分发​前​的​抛错​——​该​尝试​没有​任何​持久​ assistant ​事件​可​依附​，​终结​帧​以​ abandoned ​收口​，​消费者​知道​这条流​的​ durable ​版本​不会​出现​了​。

docs.title: 数据​出口​：​同​一批​ chunk ​的​三种​视图
docs.text:
/** Exact compact stream for the final durable event. */
get stream(): SessionEventMap['assistant/attempt']['stream'] {
  return [...this.accumulator.snapshot()] as AssistantStreamRecord[]
}

/** Canonical completed-message blocks from the same chunks. */
blocks(): ContentBlock[] {
  return this.assembler.blocks()
}

/** Safe visible prefix when cancellation interrupts the attempt. */
interruptedBlocks(): ContentBlock[] {
  return this.assembler.interruptedBlocks()
}

/** Latest adapter-reported usage in the stream. */
get usage(): TokenUsage | undefined { return this.assembler.usage }

/** Terminal reason, defaulting to stop when the stream omitted one. */
get finish(): FinishReason { return this.assembler.finish }

/** Replay state carried by the terminal finish record. */
get replayState(): ReplayEnvelope | undefined { return this.assembler.replayState }

​四个​读数​支撑​ agent.ts ​的​四种​结算​形态​：

​读数​ ​消费​场景​ stream ​写入​ assistant/message ​或​ assistant/attempt ​的​持久​流​记录​ blocks() ​正常​完成​时​组装​ createAssistantMessage() ​的​内容​ interruptedBlocks() ​取消​时​安全​的​可见​前缀​；​非空​则​提交​ interrupted: true ​的​ assistant/message ​携带​已​交付​文本​，​为​空则​落​ assistant/attempt finish 'error' | 'aborted' ​进​ agent/request-error ​重试​决策​；'max-tokens' ​直接​以​ max-tokens ​关​ step；'stop' ​为​默认​终结​ usage / replayState ​随​持久​消息​携带​适配器​报告​的​用量​与​重放​信封

docs.title: 核心​类​与​函数​（​表格​）
docs.text: 名称​ ​类别​ ​职责​ AssistantStreamAttempt class ​单次​模型​尝试​的​帧​发布​器​ + ​持久​流​累积​器​ + ​消息​组装​器​的​融合​实例​ .attemptId ​属性​ `${sessionId}:${attempt}`，Agent ​生命周期​内​唯一​ .ended getter ​是否​已​发出​终结​帧​（terminal） .start() method ​在​首个​交付​ chunk ​前​发布​ start ​帧​ .push(chunk) method ​一次​打​时间​戳​，​喂​持久​压缩​、​组装​与​发布​；index ​稠密​递增​ .settle(eventType, append) method ​先​提交​持久​事件​拿​ seq，​再发​ committed ​终结​帧​；​追加​失败​转​ abandon ​后重​抛​ .abandon() method ​无​持久​事件​可​依附​时发​ abandoned ​终结​帧​ .stream getter ​最终​持久​事件​的​精确​压缩​流​记录​ .blocks() / .interruptedBlocks() method ​规范​完成​块​；​取消​时​安全​可见​前缀​ .usage / .finish / .replayState getter ​适配器​用量​；​终结​原因​（​缺省​ stop）；​重​放​信封

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text: 对象​ ​关系​ packages/llm AssistantStreamAccumulator（​持久​压缩​）​与​ BlockAssembler（​块​组装​）​是​全部​累积​逻辑​的​所在​；StreamChunk / ContentBlock / FinishReason / TokenUsage / ReplayEnvelope ​类型​ packages/core/agent AssistantStreamFrame ​帧​类型​与​ agent/assistant-stream ​事件​；LlmAttemptId ​品牌​类型​ packages/core/session SessionEventMap['assistant/attempt']['stream'] ​的​记录​形态​；SessionSeq ​由​驱动​经​ session.append() ​获得​ agent.ts ​唯一​消费者​：​每次​尝试​构造​一个​实例​，emit ​回调​接​ dispatch.emit('agent/assistant-stream', { frame })；​取消​结算​与​重试​决策​读​它​的​四个​出口

docs.title: 小结
docs.text: AssistantStreamAttempt ​是​流​协议​的​守门员​：start → chunk → end ​三类​帧​与​持久​日志​严格​对齐​——​每个​ chunk ​帧​只​在​对应​持久​ assistant ​帧​结算​后​才​到达​（settle ​先​ append ​后发​帧​），​终结​ end ​恰好​一个​，committed ​与​ abandoned ​明确​区分​"durable ​版本​已​在​日志​里​"​与​"durable ​版本​不会​出现​"。​同​一批​ chunk ​经​两个​累积​器​产出​持久​流​记录​与​规范​内容​块​两种​视图​，​取消​时​的​ interruptedBlocks() ​保证​用户​已经​看到​的​文本​进入​下​一次​请求​。

docs.title: constants.ts — ​默认​并发​常量
docs.text:
​共享​调度​默认值​

​源码​：packages/core/agent-loop/src/constants.ts（6 ​行​）。​导出​ DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
​整个​文件​只有​一个​常量​：

/** Shared agent-loop scheduler defaults.
 * @module dsh-agent-loop/constants
 */

/** Default maximum in-flight parallel-safe calls per agent step. */
export const DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS = 10

docs.title: 为什么​单列​一个​文件
docs.text:
​这个​常量​服务​于​两个​互不​依赖​的​消费者​：

  • AgentLoop.Config（packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts）：maxParallelToolCalls ​字段​的​默认值​。​它​是​ volatile ​的​正整数​ Config ​字​段​——​部署​可以​在​ cordis.yml ​里​改​，​运行​期经​ ctx.agentLoop.config.maxParallelToolCalls.get() ​读取​，live ​编辑​对下​一批​工具​调用​生效​。
  • ​可能​的​外部​消费​：​常量​经​ index.ts ​再​导出​（export { DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS }），​独立​成​文件​让​消费者​引用​默认值​时​不必​ import ​整个​服务​模块​，​避免​为了​一个​数字​拉​起​服务​依赖图​。

​放进​独立​模块​还有​一层​秩序​意义​：​常量​属于​"​协议​/​调度​默认值​"，​不​属于​某个​类​或​服务​——agent.ts（​状态机​）​与​ index.ts（​服务​/​配置​）​都​不该​是​它​的​家​，​否则​默认值​的​可见​范围​会​与​实现​耦合​。

docs.title: 它​如何​被​使用​（​不是​硬​编码​）
docs.text:
​循环​每​一步​都​实时​读取​ volatile ​配置​而​不是​缓存​这个​常量​：

// packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts — step() ​内​
const maxParallelToolCalls = this.loopCtx.agentLoop.config.maxParallelToolCalls.get()
// ...
const result = await this.loopCtx.tools.execute({
  calls: toolCalls, signal, agent: this, log: { turn, step },
  maxParallelToolCalls, toolSet: decision.toolSet,
})

ctx.tools.execute() ​收到​的​是​当前​生效​值​，​优先​于​执行器​自身​配置​；1 ​表示​串行​。​常量​只​在​配置​ schema ​的​ .default(...) ​处​出现​一次​：

// packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts — AgentLoop.Config
maxParallelToolCalls: z.number().step(1).min(1).default(DEFAULT_MAX_PARALLEL_TOOL_CALLS).volatile(),

​这​符合​仓库​的​配置​纪律​：​部署​可变​的​取值​必须​是​可​校验​的​ Config ​字​段​，​一个​ DEFAULT_* ​常量​本身​不是​可​配置​性​——​常量​只是​字段​的​出厂​值​，​真正​的​可​配置​性由​ .volatile() ​与​ .get() ​提供​。

docs.title: inbox.ts — ​输入​收件箱
docs.text:
​持久​化​的​ agent inbox ​投影​与​驱动​命令​面​

​源码​：packages/core/agent-loop/src/inbox.ts（232 ​行​）。​导出​ inboxProjectionSchema、inboxProjectionDefinition、ReactLoopInbox。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
agent ​的​待办​输入​有​两条​有​序列表​：next-turn（​等待​独立​ turn ​的​ prompt）​与​ next-step（​等待​下​一个​ step ​边界​的​ steering / ​注入​上下文​）。​本​文件​把​这个​状态​做成​两件事​：

  1. ​持久​化​投影​（inboxProjectionDefinition）：​注册​到​ ctx.sessionProjections（​键​ inbox），​从​日志​中​的​ agent/inbox/spliced ​事件​同步​折叠​出​当前​ pending ​状态​；​折叠​器​校验​ splice ​坐标​与​跨​列表​ id ​唯一性​，​坏​的​历史​按​事件​ seq ​报错​。
  2. ​命令​面​（ReactLoopInbox）：​实现​公开​ Inbox ​契约​的​结构性​命令​（append / prepend / replace / remove / splice / clear），​所有​变更​都​归一化​为​一条​ agent/inbox/spliced ​事件​提交​；​另有​一个​不​属于​公开​契约​的​ loop-only ​操作​ claim()。

AgentLoop ​在​ Service.init ​里​注册​投影​、​再​发布​工厂​——​所以​冷读​在​任何​ Agent ​存在​前​、​全部​ Agent ​卸载​后​都​可用​；ReactLoopAgent ​构造​时​通过​ readerFor(session) ​拿到​读器​传入​。

docs.title: 投影​折叠​：​从​ durable splice ​重建​ pending ​状态
docs.text:
/** Wire validation for pending agent input reconstructed from durable inbox splices. */
export const inboxProjectionSchema = z.object({
  'next-turn': z.array(z.custom<UserMessage>()).readonly(),
  'next-step': z.array(z.custom<UserMessage>()).readonly(),
}).readonly()

/** Standard fold that reconstructs pending input and rejects invalid durable splice history. */
export const inboxProjectionDefinition = {
  key: 'inbox',
  stateSchema: inboxProjectionSchema,
  init: (): InboxState => ({ 'next-turn': [], 'next-step': [] }),
  apply(state: InboxState, event) {
    if (event.type !== 'agent/inbox/spliced') return state
    const splice = event.data
    try {
      const inbox = state[splice.target]
      const removedCount = splice.removedCount ?? 0
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(splice.start) || splice.start < 0 || splice.start > inbox.length
        || !Number.isSafeInteger(removedCount) || removedCount < 0
        || splice.start + removedCount > inbox.length) {
        throw new Error('invalid inbox splice')
      }
      const next = inbox.toSpliced(splice.start, removedCount, ...splice.inserted)
      const ids = new Set<string>()
      for (const message of splice.target === 'next-turn'
        ? [...next, ...state['next-step']]
        : [...state['next-turn'], ...next]) {
        if (ids.has(message.id)) throw new Error(`message "${message.id}" is already pending`)
        ids.add(message.id)
      }
      return splice.target === 'next-turn'
        ? { 'next-turn': next, 'next-step': state['next-step'] }
        : { 'next-turn': state['next-turn'], 'next-step': next }
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      throw new Error(`invalid persisted inbox splice at session seq ${event.seq}`, { cause: error })
    }
  },
  // ...
  stateVersion: 1,
} satisfies ProjectionDefinition<'inbox', InboxState>

​折叠​器​的​防线​有​三层​：

  • ​坐标​校验​：start / removedCount ​必须​是​安全​整数​且​落​在​列表​范围​内​，​越界​即​拒绝​——​把​畸形​持久​历史​定位​到​具体​事件​ seq。
  • ​跨​列表​ id ​唯一性​：​变更​后​合并​两个​列表​检查​ MessageId ​重复​。MessageId ​在​两条​ pending ​列表​间​全局​唯一​，​这是​ agent/inbox/* ​通知​可以​被​单条​消息​消费者​可靠​跟随​的​前提​。
  • ​不可​变更​新​：toSpliced ​产出​新​数组​，​投影​状态​是​纯值​。

wire ​视图​就是​折叠​状态​本身​：

wire: {
  // The wire value is the fold state itself: every pending message already
  // round-trips the session log as lossless JSON. Only the static type
  // narrows to the JSON-safe projection table entry.
  viewSchema: inboxProjectionSchema as unknown as z.ZodType<InboxWireState>,
  view: (state: InboxState) => state as unknown as InboxWireState,
},

pending ​消息​早已​以​无损​ JSON ​在​日志​中​往返​，wire ​层​无需​再​变换​；​唯一​的​不​匹配​是​静态​类型​，​这里​以​显式​的​窄化​注释​说明​理由​。

docs.title: ReactLoopInbox：​命令​面​与​ loop-only claim
docs.text:
export class ReactLoopInbox implements InboxContract {
  constructor(
    private readonly readState: () => InboxState,
    private readonly session: Session,
    private readonly dispatch: AgentEventDispatch,
  ) {}

  get nextTurn(): readonly UserMessage[] { return this.readState()['next-turn'] }
  get nextStep(): readonly UserMessage[] { return this.readState()['next-step'] }

  get hasPending(): boolean {
    const state = this.readState()
    return state['next-turn'].length > 0 || state['next-step'].length > 0
  }

  /** Durably cancel all pending input, clearing next-step before next-turn. */
  clear(): void {
    this.splice('next-step', 0, this.nextStep.length, [])
    this.splice('next-turn', 0, this.nextTurn.length, [])
  }

​实现​不​持有​任何​可变​状态​：​读​操作​全部​走​ readState()（​投影​读器​），​写​操作​全部​走​ mutate() ​提交​事件​。clear() ​先清​ next-step ​再清​ next-turn，​每条​移除​都​以​ outcome: 'canceled' ​记录​并发​ agent/inbox/discarded——​普通​移除​与​ clear() ​都​是​"​取消​"​语义​。

claim() ​是​唯一​的​例外​路径​：

/**
 * Remove and return the complete batch proposed for one step.
 * @param target - whether this boundary also consumes one queued turn.
 * @param turn - turn that will own the claimed batch.
 * @returns next-step input followed by the queued turn, when requested.
 */
claim(target: InboxTarget, turn: number): UserMessage[] {
  const claimed = this.mutate('next-step', 0, this.nextStep.length, [], false)
  if (target === 'next-turn') claimed.push(...this.mutate('next-turn', 0, 1, [], false))
  for (const message of claimed) this.dispatch.emit('agent/inbox/claimed', { message, turn })
  return claimed
}

claim ​与​普通​移除​的​区别​在​ mutate ​的​第五个​参数​ discardRemoved：

  • claim ​传​ false：​纯​删除​ splice——​事件​不带​ outcome，​不发​ agent/inbox/discarded，​只​逐条​发​ agent/inbox/claimed { message, turn }。
  • turn ​边界​再领​ 1 ​条​ next-turn：target === 'next-turn' ​时​在​ step ​批次​后​追加​队列​头部​的​第一条​ prompt；step ​边界​只领​ next-step ​全部​。
  • claim ​不​属于​公开​ Agent.inbox——​公开​消费者​观察​ agent/inbox/claimed ​通知​，​而​不是​调用​它​。

​其余​结构性​命令​是​ mutate ​的​薄​包装​：append / prepend / remove / ​公开​ splice ​传​ discardRemoved = true；replace ​定位​后以​"​删​ 1 ​插​ 1"​实现​，​因此​发出​旧​消息​ discarded、​新​消息​ inserted ​两条​通知​（​替换​可能​改变​身份​）。

docs.title: mutate：​归一化​、​唯一性​守卫​与​事件​提交
docs.text:
/** Commit one normalized mutation and publish its live events. */
private mutate(
  target: InboxTarget,
  start: number,
  deleteCount: number,
  inserted: UserMessage[],
  discardRemoved: boolean,
): UserMessage[] {
  const state = this.readState()
  const inbox = state[target]
  const truncatedStart = Math.trunc(start)
  const offset = Number.isNaN(truncatedStart) ? 0 : truncatedStart
  const actualStart = offset < 0
    ? Math.max(inbox.length + offset, 0)
    : Math.min(offset, inbox.length)
  const truncatedDeleteCount = Math.trunc(deleteCount)
  const actualDeleteCount = Math.min(
    Math.max(Number.isNaN(truncatedDeleteCount) ? 0 : truncatedDeleteCount, 0),
    inbox.length - actualStart,
  )
  if (actualDeleteCount === 0 && inserted.length === 0) return []
  const candidate = inbox.toSpliced(actualStart, actualDeleteCount, ...inserted)
  const ids = new Set<string>()
  for (const message of target === 'next-turn'
    ? [...candidate, ...state['next-step']]
    : [...state['next-turn'], ...candidate]) {
    if (ids.has(message.id)) throw new Error(`message "${message.id}" is already pending`)
    ids.add(message.id)
  }
  const outcome = discardRemoved && actualDeleteCount > 0 ? 'canceled' as const : undefined
  const splice: SessionEventMap['agent/inbox/spliced'] = {
    target,
    start: actualStart,
    ...(actualDeleteCount === 0 ? {} : { removedCount: actualDeleteCount }),
    inserted,
    ...(outcome === undefined ? {} : { outcome }),
  }
  const removed = inbox.slice(actualStart, actualStart + actualDeleteCount)
  const event = this.session.append('agent/inbox/spliced', splice)
  if (discardRemoved) {
    for (const message of removed) this.dispatch.emit('agent/inbox/discarded', { message })
  }
  for (const message of event.data.inserted) {
    this.dispatch.emit('agent/inbox/inserted', { message })
  }
  return removed
}

​要点​：

  • Array.prototype.splice ​的​语义​归一化​：send() ​传入​的​ Infinity ​起点​、​负​偏移​（​从​尾部​数​）、NaN ​全部​收敛​为​安全​坐标​；​零​删除​零​插入​是​ no-op，​不​提交​事件​。​折叠​器​校验​的​坐标​域​与​这里​生成​的​坐标​域​一致​。
  • ​事件​先​提交​，​通知​随后​：session.append() ​同步​落​日志​，​返回​的​ event.data.inserted ​是​提交​后​的​规范​数据​；inserted ​通知​从​提交​事件​读取​，​保证​通知​与​日志​一致​。​投影​注册表​同步​折叠​该​事件​，​所以​ Session.append() ​返回​时​活跃​投影​已​反映​拼接​结果​。
  • ​幂​等​守卫​双侧​对称​：mutate ​在​提交​前​检查​候选​ id ​集合​，​与​折叠​器​对​持久​历史​的​检查​使用​同一​规则​——​写入​侧​非法​直接​抛错​，​读取​侧​非法​按坏​历史​报错​。
