​构造函数​里​这​三段​是​服务​自己​注册​的​（packages/core/system-prompt/src/index.ts）：

// Keep harness-owned openers independent of the selected loop plugin.
if (config.includeHarnessIdentity ?? true) {
  this.section({
    name: 'harness:identity',
    order: this.getSectionOrder('HARNESS_IDENTITY'),
    text: 'You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.',
  })
}
this.section({ name: PERSONA_PREFIX_SECTION, order: this.getSectionOrder('DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX'), text: config.personaPrefix ?? '' })
this.section({ name: PERSONA_SUFFIX_SECTION, order: this.getSectionOrder('DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_SUFFIX'), text: config.personaSuffix ?? '' })

PERSONA_PREFIX_SECTION（'deployment:persona-prefix'）​导出​为​常量​的​原因​写​在​ JSDoc ​里​：agent preset ​要​用​同一个​名字​注册​ scoped ​段来​替换​部署​ persona——​两边​命名​相同​才能​"​替换​"​而​不是​"​重复​"。

docs.title: 段​注册​与​排序​：getSectionOrder
docs.text:
​段​的​完整​输入​契约​是​ PromptSection（JSDoc ​摘要​）：

export interface PromptSection {
  readonly name: string        // Unique name — a duplicate registration throws.
  readonly order: number       // Ascending; equal orders use code-unit name order.
  readonly text: string | ((context: AssembleContext) => string)  // static or per-assembly provider
  readonly interpolate?: boolean // defaults true; false preserves literal text
  readonly complete?: boolean  // become the exact complete prompt after assembly
}

​排序​函数​只有​一行​：comparePromptSections ​先比​ order，​同​序时​用​ compareNames（​码元​比较​，locale ​无关​，​任何​机器​上​顺序​一致​）。

​仓库​自有​贡献者​不​允许​随手​写​魔法​数字​，​而是​通过​ getSectionOrder() ​解析​集中​分配​的​位置​表​：

const SECTION_ORDERS = {
  HARNESS_IDENTITY: -1000,
  DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX: 0,
  PLAN_POLICY: 500,
  TEAM_POLICY: 600,
  PTC_ONLY: 800,
  FILE_REFERENCE: 900,
  TOOL_BASH: 1000,
  ...
  TOOLS_SDK: 5000,
  DELIVERABLE_FILE_REFERENCES: 9000,
  STRUCTURED_OUTPUT: 9900,
  // Local paths and endpoints follow reusable instructions.
  HARNESS_SOURCE: 10000,
  WEB_SURFACE: 10100,
  DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_SUFFIX: 10200,
} as const

​这​张表​就是​整个​ first-party ​提示​词​的​目录​：​身份​（−1000）→ ​部署​ persona ​前缀​（0）→ ​策略​段​（plan 500 / team 600 / PTC 800）→ ​各​工具​的​使用​说明​（1000–3000）→ ​可​复用​指令​（TOOLS_SDK 5000）→ ​结构化​输出​（9900）→ ​环境​性​后缀​（​本​仓库​来源​ 10000、Web ​面​ 10100、persona ​后缀​ 10200）。​动态​上下文​有​独立​的​一张​ CONTEXT_ORDERS（​工作​目录​ 100、​沙箱​策略​ 110、​审批​策略​ 115、​子​代理​委派​ 120…），​两条​位置​轴​互不​干扰​。

​外部​贡献者​可以​用​任意​有限​ order——section() ​只​拒绝​非​有限​值​，​然后​经​ this.layers.effect(this.ctx, ...) ​注册​（this.layers ​是​ ScopedLayers<PromptLayer>）。​调用​上下文​的​ scope ​标签​同时​决定​可见​性​与​销毁​所有权​——​这​正是​ scope ​模块​的​语义​（​见​ scope ​章节​）；​全局​层​与​ scoped ​层​的​重名​报错​文案​不同​，scoped ​重名​会​提示​"per-agent override ​请​走​该​ agent ​的​ agent.ctx"。

docs.title: 变量​与​严格​插值
docs.text:
​变量​由​ variable(name, provider) ​注册​，​在​段​或​上下文​文本​里​写成​ {{name}}。agent loop ​注册​了​两个​（packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts）：

ctx.systemPrompt.variable('provider', context => context.modelSelection?.provider ?? context.agent?.options.provider)
ctx.systemPrompt.variable('model', context => context.modelSelection?.model ?? context.agent?.options.model)

​所以​部署​可以​在​ personaPrefix ​模板​里​写​ You are {{model}}, ... ​引入​模型​名​简介​。​注意​ loop ​不​注册​ {{cwd}}——​工作​目录​由​ working-directory ​服务​以​字面​上下文​贡献​，​自定义​ persona ​模板​里​引用​ {{cwd}} ​会​让​组装​在​第一次​模型​请求​前​就​失败​。

​插值​发生​在​渲染​阶段​（renderPrompt），​不是​组装​阶段​，​且​极其​严格​——renderPrompt ​把​每段​按​ interpolate ​选项​走​ interpolate()，​去​空段​后​以​空行​拼接​。interpolate() ​的​失败​路径​有​四类​，​全部​抛错​：​畸形​引用​（{{ ​后​有​ }} ​但​不​构成​完整​ group）、​名字​不​匹配​正则​、​未注册​的​名字​（​用​ Object.hasOwn ​检查​，​避免​原型​链​污染​）、​已​注册​但​本次​求值​为​ undefined。​两个​刻意​的​宽容​点​：​孤立​的​ {{ ​后面​再也​没有​ }} ​时​视为​字面​散文​；​替换​后​的​值​不会​再​被​扫描​。interpolate: false ​让​整段​保持​字面​量​——​生成​型​工具​文档​或​含​ {{…}} ​的​目录名​需要​它​。

docs.title: 工具​ schema：step ​准入​（toolSet）​与​ provider ​的​交互
docs.text:
​工具​ schema ​不是​插件​直接​塞进​提示​词​的​，​而是​通过​一条​三层​协作​链​：

  1. dsh-tools ​给​ AssembleContext ​增加​准入​字​段​。AssembleContext ​是​ merge-extensible ​接口​，packages/core/tools/src/index.ts ​通过​声明​合并​加入​ step ​准入​集合​：
declare module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt' {
  interface AssembleContext {
    /** Admitted registrations for the prepared step; absent outside a model step. */
    toolSet?: ResolvedToolSet
  }
}
  1. agent loop ​在​ step ​准备​时求​出​准入​集合​并​传入​组装​（packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts ​的​ preStep）：
const toolSet = await this.loopCtx.tools.resolve({ agent: this, modelSelection: selection, signal })
const assembly = await this.loopCtx.systemPrompt.assemble({ ...assembleContextFor(this, signal), modelSelection: selection, toolSet })

assembleContextFor（packages/core/agent/src/dispatch.ts）​把​ agent ​与​ scope ​一起​填​上​——{ agent, scope: agent, ...signal === undefined ? {} : { signal } }——​避免​ agent ​级​贡献​被​静默​漏掉​。

  1. ToolRuntime ​注册​的​ schema provider ​在​组装​时​被​回调​（packages/core/tools/src/index.ts ​构造函数​）：
ctx.systemPrompt.tools(({ scope, toolSet }) => {
  const executor = this.selectExecutor(scope)
  const description = executor.describe(this.definitions(scope, toolSet))
  return { ...description, knownNames: description.knownNames ?? [...this.view(scope).knownNames] }
})

​两个​参数​分工​明确​：scope ​决定​可见​集合​（scope ​链上​的​注册​ + restriction ​过滤​），toolSet ​决定​本​ step ​的​准入​集合​（when ​条件​激活​的​结果​）。definitions(scope, toolSet) ​在​有​ toolSet ​时读​ toolSet.view(scope)，​没有​时读​注册表​视图​。native ​执行器​直接​把​每个​工具​投影​成​ schema，PTC ​执行器​折叠​成​一个​ run_code——schema ​形态​是​执行器​的​事​，registry ​只​供料​。

provider ​返回​的​ ToolProviderResult ​除​ schemas ​外​还有​一个​可​选​ knownNames：restriction ​之前​的​名字​全集​。orderTools() ​用​它​区分​"​配置​里​写错​名字​"（​抛错​）​与​"​已知​工具​在​此​ scope ​被​有意​隐藏​"（​允许​缺席​）：

function orderTools(tools: ToolSchema[], toolOrder: string[] | undefined, knownNames: ReadonlySet<string>): ToolSchema[] {
  const reserved = tools.find(tool => tool.name === TOOL_ORDER_REST)
  if (reserved !== undefined) throw new Error(`tool provider returned reserved tool name "${TOOL_ORDER_REST}" ...`)
  if (toolOrder === undefined) return tools.sort(compareToolNames)
  const unknown = toolOrder.filter(name => name !== TOOL_ORDER_REST && !knownNames.has(name))
  if (unknown.length > 0) throw new Error(`toolOrder lists unregistered tool...`)
  const listed = new Set(toolOrder)
  const rest = tools.filter(tool => !listed.has(tool.name)).sort(compareToolNames)
  return toolOrder.flatMap(name =>
    name === TOOL_ORDER_REST ? rest : tools.filter(tool => tool.name === name))
}

​每个​ provider ​的​ parameters ​都​会​ structuredClone——​收集​到​的​ schema ​与​注册表​里​的​定义​脱​关联​，​后续​ waterfall ​和​调用​方都​改​不到​原​对象​。​没有​配置​ toolOrder ​时​按​名字​典序​排序​（​注册​顺序​是​插件​加载​的​偶然​产物​，​不能​当​模型​可见​顺序​）。

docs.title: assemble() ​走读​：​遮蔽​、complete ​段​与​ waterfall
docs.text:
​组装​主体​（​省略​已​讲​过​的​工具​收集​）：

async assemble(context: AssembleContext = {}): Promise<PromptAssembly> {
  const scope = context.scope
  const scopeLayers = this.layers.chainLayers(scope)
  // Scoped variables shadow globals; scope-chain providers run farthest first,
  // so the nearest scope wins a name.
  const variables: Record<string, string | undefined> = {}
  for (const [name, provider] of this.layers.global.variables.entries()) variables[name] = provider(context)
  for (const layer of scopeLayers) {
    for (const [name, provider] of layer.variables.entries()) variables[name] = provider(context)
  }
  // Scoped sections shadow globals before the deterministic order sort.
  const sectionByName = this.layers.merge(scope, layer => layer.sections)
  const contextByName = this.layers.merge(scope, layer => layer.contexts)
  ...

​遮蔽​的​实现​是​"​先远后​近地​覆盖​同一个​ Map"，​而​不是​过滤​——​所以​近层​定义​可以​替换​远层​同名​段​而​不留​痕迹​。persona preset（packages/preset/persona/src/index.ts）​就是​这样​替​单个​ agent ​换​身份​的​：

ctx.effect(() => ctx.systemPrompt.section({
  name: PERSONA_PREFIX_SECTION,
  order: ctx.systemPrompt.getSectionOrder('DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX'),
  text: config.prefix,
  ...(config.complete ? { complete: true } : {}),
}), 'persona.section()')

complete ​段​的​处理​分​两步​：​组装​前​检查​最​多​一个​ effective complete ​段​（​多个​直接​抛错​）；waterfall ​之后​恢复​它​为​唯一​的​段​列表​。​这样​ cooperative waterfall ​仍然​跑​完​——​工具​、​上下文​、​变量​照常​解析​——​但​ listener ​无法​往​一个​声明​了​ complete ​的​ scope ​提示​词里​添​内容​：

const transformed = await this.ctx.waterfall(
  scopeTarget(this, scope), 'system-prompt/assemble', assembly, context,
  () => Promise.resolve(assembly),
)
if (completeSection === undefined && !runtimeContextSuppressed) return { ...transformed, tools }
return {
  ...transformed,
  tools,
  sections: completeSection === undefined ? transformed.sections : [completeSection],
  contexts: runtimeContextSuppressed ? transformed.contexts.filter(entry => requiredContexts.has(entry.name)) : transformed.contexts,
}

waterfall ​的​ this ​是​ Scoped<SystemPrompt> ​载体​（scopeTarget(this, scope)）：​只有​ tag ​等于​该​ scope（​或​其​祖先​）​的​ listener ​参与​，​未​打​ tag ​的​全局​ listener ​也​参与​。​事件​声明​强制​这个​载体​作为​ this ​类型​，​直接​用​裸​ service ​派发​是​编译​错误​。

docs.title: refreshContext：​准入​前​的​轻量​刷新
docs.text: agent/request ​重试​或​路由​准备​之后​，​事实​可能​已经​变化​（​比如​工作​目录​被​切换​）。refreshContext(assembly, context) ​只重​跑​注册​的​上下文​ provider：waterfall ​追加​的​上下文​保留​原值​，​当前​ suppress ​状态​移除​可​选​上下文​，​缺失​的​ required ​注册​按​注册​顺序​补回​位置​。​段​、​工具​、​变量​保留​已​接受​的​组装​值​——provider ​与​ waterfall ​不重​跑​。loop ​在​ step() ​里​每次​尝试​请求​前​调用​它​（​见​ packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts）。

docs.title: system/message：​提示​词​历史​如何​落账
docs.text:
​渲染​出​的​提示​词​不​作为​请求​字​段​传输​，​而是​作为​派生​历史​里​的​ system ​消息​节点​。packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts ​的​ step()：

const renderedPrompt = renderPrompt(assembly)
...
const commits = this.systemPrompt.project(renderedPrompt, {
  inHistory: preparedCall?.systemPromptUpdate === 'in-history',
  startsSeries: ...,
})
for (const { message, intent } of commits) {
  this.session.append('system/message', { turn, step, message }, intent)
}

SystemPromptProjection（packages/core/agent-loop/src/runtime-context.ts）​把​"​本次​渲染​文本​"​对账​到​既有​的​ system/message ​表面​节点​：​没有​节点​则​ append（​第一个​ step ​的​表面​节点​ 0）；​文本​未变​则​零​提交​，​前缀​缓存​不​受​影响​；​文本​变​了​默认​原地​替换​（​空​文本​时逐​节点​清空​，​历史​里​不留​旧​提示​词​），​而​声明​ systemPromptUpdate: 'in-history' ​的​调用​在​延续​请求​系列​里​改为​在​缓存​历史​之后​追加​新​提示​词​，​保住​既有​前缀​的​复用​。

​动态​上下文​是​另​一路​：renderContextSections + joinContextSections ​拼出​的​快照​（​带​头部​ Current runtime context. This snapshot supersedes earlier runtime-context snapshots.）​作为​ user ​消息​ append，​只​在​内容​变化​或​被​压缩​移除​后​重新​落账​。​段​是​ system ​消息​、​上下文​是​ user ​快照​——​这​就是​ PromptSection ​与​ PromptContext ​分成​两个​注册​ API ​的​原因​。

docs.title: 扩展​点​：​新增​一个​ section ​的​做法
docs.text:
​仓库​自有​贡献者​（​占​了​集中​位置​表​的​名字​）：​在​插件​里​用​ getSectionOrder() ​解析​位置​，​不要​手写​数字​。​跨​调用​生效​的​使用​说明​段​是​典型​——packages/shell/tool-bash/src/index.ts：

// Cross-call guidance belongs in the prompt rather than one-call schema prose.
ctx.systemPrompt.section({
  name: 'tool:bash',
  order: ctx.systemPrompt.getSectionOrder('TOOL_BASH'),
  text: 'Check the [exit code: N] marker on every bash result; investigate failures before moving on.',
})

​需要​新​位置​时先​在​ SECTION_ORDERS ​里​分配​（​保持​稀疏​、​留出​插入​空间​），​再​让​贡献​插件​引用​它​。

​工具​类段​要​感知​ step ​准入​：restriction ​不​移除​段​注册​，​所以​工具​说明​段​应该​在​工具​不​可见​时​输出​空​文本​。​执行器​自有​段​由​ setExecutor() ​自动​包装​成​ toolSet ​感知​回调​（packages/core/tools/src/index.ts）：

text: ({ scope, toolSet }) => {
  if (this.selectExecutor(scope) !== executor) return ''
  return typeof section.text === 'function' ? section.text(this.definitions(scope, toolSet)) : section.text
},

​外部​贡献者​可用​任意​有限​ order；​文本​可以​是​ string，​也​可以​是​接收​ AssembleContext ​的​函数​（​可​读​ context.toolSet ​检查​与​执行​同​一步​的​准入​集合​）。

​动态​事实​放​ context ​而​不是​ section：​事实​会​变化​的​（​工作​目录​、​审批​策略​）​注册​成​ PromptContext，​由​ working-directory ​服务​示范​——required: true ​保证​被​压制​时​仍然​可见​，interpolate: false ​保证​目录名​里​的​ {{…}} ​不会​炸​插值​（packages/session/working-directory/src/index.ts）：

ctx.systemPrompt.context({
  name: 'working-directory:current',
  order: ctx.systemPrompt.getContextOrder('WORKING_DIRECTORY'),
  required: true,
  interpolate: false,
  text: context => context.agent === undefined ? '' : this.contextText(context.agent.session),
})

​它​还​监听​ system-prompt/assemble，​在​ waterfall ​里​把​最新​目录​文本​写回​ assembly——​这是​上下文​贡献​的​另​一种​合法​形态​（waterfall ​追加​）。

per-agent ​覆盖​：​走​ agent.ctx.systemPrompt... ​注册​，​同名​遮蔽​全局​，​随​ agent ​销毁​自动​反​注册​。

docs.title: 核心​函数​表
docs.text: 函数​/​方法​ ​位置​ ​一句​话​ SystemPrompt.section/context/variable/tools/suppressRuntimeContext packages/core/system-prompt/src/index.ts ​五类​注册​，scope ​感知​，​返回​精确​ disposer getSectionOrder / getContextOrder ​同​上​ ​集中​命名​位置​ → ​数字​ assemble(context) ​同​上​ ​遮蔽​合并​ → ​排序​ → ​工具​收集​排序​ → scope ​过滤​ waterfall → complete ​恢复​ refreshContext(assembly, context) ​同​上​ ​准入​前​只​刷新​注册​上下文​（required ​恢复​、suppress ​生效​） renderPrompt(assembly) ​同​上​ ​插值​ + ​去​空段​ + ​空行​拼接​ renderContextSections / joinContextSections / renderContextSnapshot ​同​上​ ​上下文​快照​的​具名​渲染​与​拼接​ interpolate ​同​上​ ​严格​ {{variable}} ​插值​（​畸形​/​未知​/​未定义​抛错​） orderTools / validateToolOrder ​同​上​ ​配置​顺序​应用​；​形状​错误​加载​时​抛​，​未知​名字​组装​时​抛​ assembleContextFor(agent, signal?) packages/core/agent/src/dispatch.ts agent + scope + signal ​一起​填​的​组装​上下文​ SystemPromptProjection.project packages/core/agent-loop/src/runtime-context.ts ​渲染​文本​对账​到​ system/message ​表面​节点

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• scope（packages/core/scope）：PromptLayer ​基于​ ScopedLayers/NamedEntries/AnonymousEntries；waterfall ​用​ scopeTarget ​做​ scope ​过滤​派发​。scoping ​语义​见​ scope ​章节​。
  • tools：​声明​合并​给​ AssembleContext ​加​ toolSet；ToolRuntime ​构造​时​注册​ schema provider；setExecutor ​把​执行器​自有​段​包成​ toolSet ​感知​回调​。
  • agent / agent-loop：assembleContextFor ​统一​组装​上下文​；loop ​是​ assemble()、refreshContext()、renderPrompt() ​的​唯一​调用​方​，​并​把​渲染​结果​落成​ system/message / user ​快照​。agent/pre-step waterfall ​在​组装​之后​运行​，listener ​可​拒绝​该​ step。
  • ​配置​与​ persona：Config ​持有​全局​ persona；packages/preset/persona ​用​同名​ scoped ​段​替换​单个​ agent ​的​ persona。
  • ​事实​拥有者​插件​：working-directory、sandbox-policy、user-approval、plan-mode、​各​工具​插件​等​各自​注册​自己​拥有​的​段​/​上下文​——​提示​词​事实​的​归属​见​ Agent Note（.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-07-05-prompt-variables-and-tool-guidance-ownership.md）。

docs.title: 小结
docs.text: dsh-system-prompt ​是​"​注册表​ + ​协作​组装​管线​"：​插件​通过​ ctx.systemPrompt ​注册​段​、​变量​、​上下文​与​工具​ schema provider，loop ​每​ step ​调​一次​ assemble()。​三个​不变式​贯穿​全​模块​——​顺序​确定​（order ​升序​ + ​码元​名序​，​位置​由​集中​表​分配​）、​遮蔽​显式​（scope ​同名​替换​全局​，​重复​注册​响亮​失败​）、​失败​响亮​（​畸形​变量​、​多个​ complete ​段​、​未知​ toolOrder ​名​都​不会​产出​畸形​提示​词​）。​渲染​与​落账​的​另一半​在​ agent loop：​段​变成​ system/message ​表面​节点​，​上下文​变成​ user ​快照​，​工具​ schema ​随​请求​头​传输​——​模型​可见​的​一切​都​能​从​ session ​日志​重建​。

docs.title: 第​ 9 ​章​ Tools：​工具​注册表​与​执行​管线
docs.text:
packages/core/tools（npm ​包名​ @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools）​是​ harness ​的​工具​中枢​：​它​提供​ ctx.tools ​这个​服务​，​所有​工具​插件​把​ ToolDefinition ​注册​进来​，​所有​ agent ​循环​通过​它​把​模型​发出​的​ tool-call ​批次​交给​执行器​执行​。​它​是​"​注册表​ + ​执行​管线​"​两层​：

  • ​注册​表层​：​维护​按​ scope ​分层​的​工具​定义​（ScopedLayers），​自动​把​可见​工具​的​ name/description/parameters ​投影​进​ system prompt ​组装​；
  • ​执行​管线​层​：​内置​执行器​（native / PTC）​复用​共享​的​ ToolExecutionPipeline —— ​三段​ waterfall（tools/pre-execute → tools/execute → tools/post-execute）​加​单调​ guard ​和​只读​ tools/result，​把​"​权限​、​超时​、​改写​结果​、​观察​"​这些​横切​策略​从​工具​本体​里​剥离​出去​。

​一个​关键​设计​：​注册​即​可见​。​工具​插件​只要​ ctx.tools.register(defineTool({...}))，​它​的​参数​ schema ​就​会​自动​进入​下​一次​提示​词​组装​，​不​需要​任何​"​把​工具​塞进​提示​词​"​的​额外​步骤​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 文件​ ​角色​ packages/core/tools/src/index.ts ​插件​入口​：ToolsService（​注册表​ + scoped ​执行器​分发​ + guard ​注册​），​本文​讲​ packages/core/tools/src/contracts.ts ​全部​核心​类型​契约​：ToolDefinition、​执行​对象​、​结果​联合​、​决策​类型​、guard、restriction packages/core/tools/src/events.ts 5 ​个​共享​事件​的​声明​合并​（​三段​ waterfall + ​两个​ emit） packages/core/tools/src/executor.ts ToolExecutor ​契约​与​原始​批次​输入​/​输出​类型​、​批次​级​错误​ packages/core/tools/src/pipeline.ts ​共享​调用​管线​：prepare / dispatch / complete ​三​阶段​、​取消​语义​、​结果​规范化​ packages/core/tools/src/batch.ts ​批次​调度​：exclusive ​屏障​ + parallel ​滚动​池​、​有序​落账​、Session ​日志​ packages/core/tools/src/schema.ts ​统一​ schema DSL、​类型​推导​、defineTool、​模型​可见​ schema ​投影​ packages/core/tools/src/json-schema.ts ​受​支持​的​ JSON Schema ​子集​：​断言​与值​校验​ packages/core/tools/src/presentation.ts UI ​渲染​意图​词汇​（generic/terminal/diff/search/read/web ​卡片​）

docs.title: 执行​管线​总览
docs.text:
​一次​模型​工具​调用​从​发出​到​落账​的​完整​路径​（ASCII ​版​，​对应​ docs/tool-execution-pipeline.md ​的​ mermaid ​图​）：

​模型​ assistant ​消息​携带​ tool-call block
        │
        ▼
ctx.tools.execute(batch) ── ​选择​最近​ scope ​的​ ToolExecutor（native / PTC）
        │
        ▼
batch.ts executeToolBatch ── exclusive ​屏障​ / parallel ​滚动​池​排程​
        │                     start(): ​追加​ tool/call ​事件​
        ▼
pipeline.ts prepare() ── ​参数​ lossless JSON ​快照​ + deepFreeze + ​分配​ token
        │
        ▼
tools/pre-execute waterfall ── ​可​重排​的​ allow / deny / cancel / ask
        │                        ask → ctx.approval ​一次性​审批​
        ▼
ctx.tools.checkGuards() ── ​注册​式​单调​ guard：​返回​ reason ​即​ deny，
        │                    ​后来​的​ listener ​无法​翻案​为​放行​
        ▼ allow
pipeline.ts dispatch() ── tools/execute waterfall（​超时​/​重试​等​ around ​包装​，
        │                   ​唯一​可以​换​ signal ​的​一段​）
        ▼
​工具​ execute(args, exec) ​正文​ ── ​正文​必须​观察​ exec.signal ​协作​取消​
        │
        ▼
pipeline.ts complete() ── projectContent（​正文​预备​内容​）
        │                   tools/post-execute waterfall（accept/replace/block）
        │                   finalizeContent（​定义​自有​的​最后​内容​变换​）
        │                   tools/result（emit：​冻结​后​的​最终​结果​，​观察者​失败​被​包容​）
        ▼
batch.ts commit() ── ​追加​ tool/result ​事件​（content/error/meta）
        │             additionalContexts ​按​模型​顺序​收集​
        ▼
ToolBatchResult ── ​回到​ agent loop，​进入​下​一步​请求​

​三段​ waterfall ​各司其职​：

​事件​ ​模式​ ​挂​什么​ ​能​做​什么​ tools/pre-execute waterfall ​审批​策略​、hooks、​沙箱​预检​ allow / deny / cancel / ask（ask ​走​ ctx.approval）；​不能​改写​参数​ tools/execute waterfall ​超时​（dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy）、​重试​、​指标​ around ​包装​ dispatch；​只能​替换​ exec.signal，​身份​字​段​不可​变​ tools/post-execute waterfall ​结果​改写​、​纠错​反馈​、​上下文​注入​ accept（​换​ content ​或​ value）/ block（​变成​ isError） tools/result emit ​遥测​、​审计​ ​只读​观察​冻结​结果​；​观察者​抛错​被​记录​并​包容​ tools/change emit ​提示​词​缓存​失效​等​ ​注册表​变化​通知​（​无​参数​）

guard ​不​经过​事件​系统​：ctx.tools.guard(fn) ​把​函数​存进​ GuardLayer，​管线​在​ pre-execute ​决议​之后​、dispatch ​之前​调​ ctx.tools.checkGuards(exec)。​它​的​返回​类型​刻意​没有​ allow —— ​返回​ reason ​只能​把​权限​调低​，​所以​ listener ​顺序​永远​无法​把​一次​拒绝​翻案​成​放行​（​单调​ deny）。

docs.title: 服务​声明​与​配置
docs.text:
/** Concrete tool registry and scoped executor dispatcher. */
export class ToolsService extends Service {
  static inject = ['systemPrompt']
  static Config = z.object({
    mode: z.never().description('Removed. Mount a native or PTC tool executor instead.'),
    maxParallelSubCalls: z.never().description('Moved to the PTC tool executor configuration.'),
  })

​两个​配置​字段​用​ z.never() ​显式​声明​为​"​已​移除​"：​旧​部署​里​还​在​写​ mode / maxParallelSubCalls ​的​ cordis.yml ​会​在​加载​时炸出​明确​错误​（misconfiguration fails loud），​而​不是​被​静默​忽略​。​并发​上限​已经​搬​去​ PTC ​执行器​自己​的​配置​。

docs.title: 注册表​的​三层​结构
docs.text:
/** One registered definition and its step-time activation condition. */
interface ToolRegistration {
  readonly definition: ToolDefinition
  readonly when: ToolRegistrationOptions['when']
}

/** One scope's complete tool-registry contribution. */
class ToolLayer implements ScopeLayer {
  readonly tools: NamedEntries<ToolRegistration>
  readonly restrictions = new AnonymousEntries<CompiledToolRestriction>()

​每个​ scope ​一层​ ToolLayer：tools ​是​具名​条目​（​同名​注册​报错​，​全局​层​与​ scoped ​层​的​报错​文案​不同​），restrictions ​是​匿名​条目​（​一个​ scope ​可以​叠加​多条​限制​）。​整个​服务​再包​一层​ ScopedLayers，​层​的​任何​增删​都​会​触发​ tools/change：

private readonly layers = new ScopedLayers(scope => new ToolLayer(scope), () => { this.ctx.emit('tools/change') })

docs.title: 构造函数​：schema ​自动​进​提示​词
docs.text:
constructor(ctx: Context) {
  super(ctx, 'tools')
  ctx.systemPrompt.tools(({ scope, toolSet }) => {
    const executor = this.selectExecutor(scope)
    const description = executor.describe(this.definitions(scope, toolSet))
    return { ...description, knownNames: description.knownNames ?? [...this.view(scope).knownNames] }
  })
}

​这​就是​"​注册​即​可见​"​的​机制​：system-prompt ​组装​请求​时会​回调​这里​。registry ​把​当前​ scope ​可见​的​定义​列表​交给​当前​ scope ​选中​执行器​的​ describe()，​由​执行器​决定​线上​的​ ToolSchema[] ​形态​ —— native ​直接​暴露​每个​工具​，PTC ​则​折叠​成​一个​ run_code。knownNames ​用于​提示​词里​工具​顺序​的​校验​兜底​。

docs.title: register()：​注册​即​生效
docs.text:
register(definition: ToolDefinition, options: ToolRegistrationOptions = {}): () => void {
  const name = definition.name
  const output = (definition as Partial<ToolDefinition>).output
  if (output === undefined || typeof output !== 'object'
    || typeof output.render !== 'function'
    || (output.presentationMeta !== undefined && typeof output.presentationMeta !== 'function')) {
    throw new TypeError(`tool "${name}" must declare output { schema, render, presentationMeta? }`)
  }
  assertSupportedJsonSchema(output.schema)
  const timeoutMs = definition.timeoutMs
  if (timeoutMs !== undefined
    && (!Number.isFinite(timeoutMs) || timeoutMs <= 0)) {
    throw new TypeError(`tool "${name}" timeoutMs must be a positive finite number`)
  }
  // Reserved unconditionally: any agent may select a code mode for itself,
  // so a name free to take under the deployment default would become a
  // collision the moment a preset mounted.
  if (name === RUN_CODE_NAME) {
    throw new Error(`tool name "${RUN_CODE_NAME}" is reserved for the PTC mode presentation transport and cannot be registered or shadowed`)
  }
  return this.layers.effect(
    this.ctx,
    layer => layer.tools.insert(name, { definition, when: options.when }),
    { label: 'tools.register()' },
  )
}

​四个​检查​：output ​声明​必须​有​ schema + render；​原始​ output schema ​必须​落​在​受​支持​的​ JSON Schema ​子集​里​；timeoutMs ​必须​是​正​有限​数​（​注意​它​只是​声明​，registry ​从不​强制​超时​ —— ​强制​需要​ dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy ​这个​ tools/execute ​包装​插件​）；run_code ​是​ PTC ​传输​保留​名​，​任何​ scope ​都​不能​注册​或​遮蔽​。​返回值​是​精确​的​ disposer（effect ​注册​，​随​插件​卸载​自动​反​注册​）。

docs.title: view()：scope ​链上​的​可见​性​推导
docs.text:
private view(scope?: ScopeKey): ToolView {
  const layers = this.layers.chainLayers(scope)
  const own = this.layers.peek(scope)
  const inherited = new Map(this.layers.global.tools.entries())
  for (const layer of layers) {
    if (layer === own) continue
    for (const [name, registration] of layer.tools.entries()) inherited.set(name, registration)
  }
  const visible = new Map<string, ToolDefinition>()
  ...
  for (const [name, registration] of inherited) {
    knownNames.add(name)
    restrictableNames.add(name)
    if (layers.every(layer => layer.admits(name))) {
      visible.set(name, registration.definition)
      registrations.set(name, registration)
    }
  }
  if (own !== undefined) {
    for (const [name, registration] of own.tools.entries()) {
      knownNames.add(name)
      visible.set(name, registration.definition)   // ​自有​注册​豁免​ restriction
      registrations.set(name, registration)
    }
  }
  return { visible, registrations, knownNames, restrictableNames }
}

​规则​：​沿​ scope ​链​从​远​到​近​收集​继承​的​工具​，​近层​遮蔽​远层​；​每​一层​的​ restriction ​都​要​放行​，​继承​工具​才​可见​；​而​查看​ scope ​自己​注册​的​工具​豁免​所有​ restriction —— ​这样​被​委派​的​子​ agent ​不会​把​自己​要用​的​工具​过滤​掉​。​一次​遍历​同时​产出​四样​东西​：​可见​定义​、​注册​条目​（​给​ executable ​判断​ when ​用​）、​限制​前​的​全部​名字​（knownNames）、​可​被​ restriction ​点名​的​全局​名​。

docs.title: resolve()：​条件​激活​（step ​级​准入​）
docs.text:
async resolve(context: ToolActivationContext): Promise<ResolvedToolSet> {
  const { agent, signal } = context
  signal.throwIfAborted()
  const view = this.view(agent)
  const admitted = new Map<string, ToolDefinition>()
  for (const [name, definition] of view.visible) {
    const registration = view.registrations.get(name)
    let enabled: boolean
    try {
      enabled = registration?.when === undefined || await registration.when(context)
    } catch (cause: unknown) {
      signal.throwIfAborted()
      throw new ToolActivationError(name, cause)
    }
    ...
  }
  let closed = false
  return Object.freeze({
    dispose: () => { closed = true },
    view: (scope) => { /* closed ​或​ scope ​不​匹配​ → ​空​；​否则​按​当前​注册表​复核​ */ },
  })
}

register(def, { when }) ​的​条件​函数​在​每个​模型​ step ​前​被​ resolve() ​逐一​求值​：​条件​抛错​不是​"​该​工具​这步​不可​用​"，​而是​ ToolActivationError（TOOL_ACTIVATION_FAILED）​让​ step ​准备​失败​ —— ​因为​"​不​知道​工具​在​不​在​"​和​"​确定​不​在​"​是​两回事​。​返回​的​ ResolvedToolSet ​被​ agent loop ​传给​提示​词​组装​和​本​ step ​的​整个​批次​（​含​ PTC ​子​调用​），step ​结束​后​ dispose。view() ​每次​读取​都​按​当前​注册表​复核​"​当初​准入​的​定义​是否​还是​原来​那个​注册​条目​"，​所以​ dispose、​同​名校​换​、​新​ restriction ​都​会​让​未​启动​的​调用​失效​，​但​已​被​准入​的​注册​无法​靠​"​迟到​的​条件​结果​"​复活​。

docs.title: 执行器​选择​与​批次​分发
docs.text:
async execute(input: ToolBatchInput): Promise<ToolBatchResult> {
  return this.selectExecutor(input.agent).execute(input)
}

private selectExecutor(scope?: ScopeKey): ToolExecutor {
  let record: Registration | undefined
  for (const key of scopeChainOf(scope)) {
    record = this.scoped.get(key)
    if (record !== undefined) break
  }
  record ??= this.root
  const executor = record?.executor
  if (executor === undefined) throw new ToolExecutorUnavailableError()
  return executor
}

setExecutor() ​每个​ scope ​只​允许​一个​执行器​（​重复​注册​报错​）；​卸载​时​只​把​ record.executor = undefined ​而​保留​记录​ —— ​这样​一个​已​接受​的​批次​不会​被​"​掉落​"​到​另​一个​执行器​上​，​新​批次​则​拒绝​直到​换上​替代品​。registry ​与​执行器​的​分工​是​：registry ​管​"​谁​能​被​调用​"（​定义​、​限制​、​准入​），​执行器​管​"​怎么​调用​"（​原生​ function-calling ​还是​ PTC ​的​ run_code ​程序​）。​两者​的​详细​对照​见​ executors ​章节​。

docs.title: guard ​注册​与​检查
docs.text:
guard(guard: ToolGuard): () => void {
  return this.guards.effect(this.ctx, layer => layer.guards.append(guard), { label: 'tools.guard()' })
}

checkGuards(exec: ToolExecution): string | undefined {
  for (const layer of [this.guards.global, ...this.guards.chainLayers(exec.agent)]) {
    for (const guard of layer.guards.values()) {
      const reason = guard(exec)
      if (reason !== undefined) return reason
    }
  }
  return undefined
}

guard ​也​是​ scoped ​分层​的​：​全局​层​先查​，​再​沿​ agent ​的​ scope ​链​；​第一个​返回​ reason ​的​ guard ​赢​。​管线​（pipeline.ts ​的​ prepare）​在​ pre-execute waterfall ​决议​为​ allow ​之后​调用​这里​，​所以​ guard ​是​最后​的​、​不可​协商​的​预​分发​策略​。

docs.title: 模块​声明​合并
docs.text: index.ts ​顶部​有​三处​ declare module：​给​ Context ​挂​ tools ​属性​、​给​ AssembleContext ​挂​ toolSet（step ​准入​）、​给​ MessageSourceMap ​挂​ 'tool-registry'（​注册表​变化​作为​消息来源​标记​）。​文件​尾部​ export * ​重​导出​四个​子​模块​的​全部​公开​ API，​并​提供​别名​ export { ToolsService as ToolRuntime }。

docs.title: 推荐​阅读​顺序
docs.text:
1. ​本文​ + contracts.md —— ​先​建立​类型​词汇表​：​工具​定义​、​执行​对象​、​结果​联合​、​决策​类型​。
  2. events.md —— 5 ​个​事件​各自​的​签名​与​挂点​。
  3. executor.md —— ​批次​的​输入​/​输出​契约​，​以及​执行器​插件​要​实现​什么​。
  4. pipeline.md —— ​单次​调用​的​ prepare / dispatch / complete ​三​阶段​，​本​模块​最​核心​的​文件​。
  5. batch.md —— ​多​调用​的​并发​调度​、​有序​落账​、​取消​与​日志​。
  6. schema.md —— defineTool ​与​ schema DSL，​工具​作者​每天​都​打交道​的​一层​。
  7. json-schema.md —— ​上面​一切​的​校验​底座​。
  8. presentation.md —— UI ​卡片​词汇​，​与​执行​完全​解​耦​。

​配套​外部​文档​：packages/core/tools/README.md（​包​契约​）、docs/subsystems/tools.md（​完整​类型​与​生成​目录​）、docs/tool-execution-pipeline.md（​管线​图​）。

docs.title: 扩展​点​速查
docs.text: 想​做​什么​ ​用​什么​ ​位置​ ​提供​一个​新​工具​ ctx.tools.register(defineTool({...})) ​工具​插件​ ​按​ step/model ​条件​启用​工具​ register(def, { when }) + agent loop ​的​ resolve() contracts.ts / index.ts ​收窄​某​ agent ​能​看到​的​全局​工具​ ctx.tools.restrict({ allow? , deny? }) index.ts ​不可​翻案​的​策略​拒绝​ ctx.tools.guard(fn)（​单调​ deny） index.ts / ​管线​ prepare ​可​重排​的​ allow/deny/ask ​审批​门​ ​监听​ tools/pre-execute waterfall events.ts ​给​所有​调用​加​超时​/​重试​/​指标​ ​监听​ tools/execute waterfall（around） events.ts ​检查​/​替换​/​阻断​结果​、​注入​上下文​ ​监听​ tools/post-execute waterfall events.ts ​只读​观察​最终​结果​ ​监听​ tools/result（emit，​观察者​失败​被​包容​） events.ts ​更换​模型​交互​形态​（​原生​ vs ​代码​模式​） ctx.tools.setExecutor(executor) —— native ​或​ PTC ​见​ executors ​章节​ ​自定义​卡片​渲染​意图​ presentCall / presentResult（​纯​函数​） presentation.ts

docs.title: 小结
docs.text: packages/core/tools ​把​"​工具​"​这件​事​拆成​四个​互相​正交​的​关注​面​：​声明​（defineTool + schema DSL，​类型​安全​）、​准入​（scope ​分层​注册​、restriction、​条件​ when、​单调​ guard）、​执行​（executor ​选择​ + ​三段​ waterfall ​管线​ + ​协作​取消​）、​呈现​（presentation.ts ​渲染​意图​ + presentationMeta ​持久​化元​数据​）。​每个​面都​可以​独立​扩展​，​而​所有​这些​机制​共同​维持​两条​铁律​：​模型​可见​的​一切​都​来自​注册表​的​白名单​投影​（output/execute/​回调​永不​上​ wire），​任何​失败​（​未知​工具​、​非法​参数​、​策略​拒绝​、​取消​）​都​变成​结构化​的​ isError ​结果​而​不是​中断​ turn。

docs.title: batch.ts — ​批次​调度
docs.text:
​批次​调度​：​屏障​、​滚动​池​与​有序​落账​

packages/core/tools/src/batch.ts ​解决​"​一个​模型​ step ​发出​ N ​个​工具​调用​怎么​跑​"​的​问题​。​它​把​ pipeline.md ​的​三​阶段​ API（prepare/dispatch/complete）​编排​成​一条​调度​规则​：exclusive ​调用​独占​成​屏障​；parallel ​调用​进有界​滚动​池​；​策略​、​结果​与​结果​上下文​始终​按​模型​顺序​落定​；abort ​或​调度​器​内部​失败​都​停止​补充​新​调用​并​排空​已​启动​的​调用​。​文件​顶部​的​模块​ JSDoc ​就是​它​的​完整​契约​说明​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 成员​ ​职责​ executeToolBatch() ​批次​入口​：​参数​校验​ → ​计划​调用​ → ​分组​循环​ → ​汇总​结果​ runGroup() ​一组​的​执行​：​滚动​池​ + ​有序​提交​ + ​取消​/​失败​排空​ BatchSettlement ​结果​收集器​：Session tool/call/tool/result ​事件​ + ​结果​/​上下文​聚合​ parseArguments() ​宽容​解析​模型​参数​ JSON PlannedCall / Slot / GroupOutcome ​内部​流转​结构

docs.title: 1. ​批次​入口​ executeToolBatch()
docs.text:
export async function executeToolBatch(
  input: ToolBatchInput,
  pipeline: ToolExecutionPipeline,
  maxParallel: () => number,
): Promise<ToolBatchResult> {
  const { calls: toolCalls, signal, agent, toolSet, maxParallelToolCalls } = input
  if (maxParallelToolCalls !== undefined && (!Number.isInteger(maxParallelToolCalls) || maxParallelToolCalls < 1)) {
    throw new RangeError('maxParallelToolCalls must be a positive integer')
  }
  const settlement = new BatchSettlement(input)
  try {
    // Inputs are distinct because tools/execute wrappers may replace `exec.signal`.
    const planned: PlannedCall[] = toolCalls.map(block => ({
      block,
      exec: {
        callId: block.id,
        name: block.name,
        arguments: parseArguments(block.arguments),
        ...agent === undefined ? {} : { agent },
        ...toolSet === undefined ? {} : { toolSet },
        signal,
      },
    }))

    let next = 0
    let concluded = false
    while (next < planned.length) {
      // Commit before classifying again so registry changes affect unstarted calls.
      const first = planned[next]!
      const mode = pipeline.executionMode(first.exec).kind
      const group = mode === 'parallel' ? planned.slice(next) : [first]
      const outcome = await runGroup(
        pipeline, settlement, maxParallelToolCalls ?? maxParallel(), group, mode, signal,
      )
      next += outcome.consumed
      concluded ||= outcome.concluded
      if (outcome.aborted) {
        for (const call of planned.slice(next)) settlement.skip(call.block)
        return settlement.result(concluded)
      }
    }
    return settlement.result(concluded)
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    throw new ToolBatchExecutionError(error, settlement.result())
  }
}

​要点​逐条​：

  • ​显式​并发​覆盖​必须​是​正整数​，​否则​同步​抛​ RangeError（misconfiguration fails loud）；​否则​用​ maxParallel() —— ​一个​惰性​读取​执行器​当前​配置​的​函数​（() => number，​这样​执行器​配置​在​批次​中途​变化​也​能​被​看到​）。
  • ​每个​ PlannedCall ​携带​独立​的​ exec ​对象​（​相同​ signal ​引用​没关系​，​因为​ tools/execute ​包装者​可能​替换​ exec.signal，​共享​对象​会​互相​污染​ —— ​注释​原话​ "Inputs are distinct because..."）。
  • ​分组​循环​每次​迭代​重新​分类​：​先​提交​上​一组​的​已​就绪​结果​，​再用​当前​注册表​给​下​一组​分类​ —— ​注册表​在​批次​中途​变化​（dispose、​新​ restriction）​会​影响​还​没​启动​的​调用​。
  • ​组​被​ abort ​时​，​剩余​未​启动​调用​逐个​ settlement.skip() ​记​成​合成​结果​，​保证​"​每个​输入​调用​恰​一条​结果​"。
  • ​任何​内部​异常​都​包成​ ToolBatchExecutionError，partial ​里​带​着​已​落账​的​结果​。

docs.title: 2. parseArguments() — ​宽容​解析
docs.text:
/** Parse model arguments, preserving invalid JSON as text and mapping empty input to `{}`. */
function parseArguments(raw: string): unknown {
  try {
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {}
  } catch (_error: unknown) {
    // Preserve malformed model input for tool-owned argument diagnostics.
    return raw
  }
}

​空串​映射​成​ {}（​模型​常发​ {} ​的​空参​调用​）；​畸形​ JSON ​不​抛错​，​原样​以​字符串​传下去​ —— ​让​工具​自己​的​参数​校验​（defineTool ​的​ ToolArgsError）​去​产出​对模型​最有​诊断​价值​的​错误​消息​，​而​不是​在​调度​层​就​变成​不可​读​的​失败​。​注意​管线​随后​会​对​它​做​ lossless ​快照​检查​，​字符串​天然​合法​。

docs.title: 3. runGroup() — ​滚动​池​与​有序​提交
docs.text:
async function runGroup(
  pipeline: ToolExecutionPipeline,
  settlement: BatchSettlement,
  maxParallelToolCalls: number,
  group: PlannedCall[],
  mode: ToolExecutionMode['kind'],
  signal: AbortSignal,
): Promise<GroupOutcome> {
  const slots: (Slot | undefined)[] = group.map(() => undefined)
  // Started slots retain their `tool/call` seq so the result can cite it.
  const callSeqs: Array<SessionSeq | undefined> = group.map(() => undefined)
  let nextToStart = 0
  let committed = 0
  let started = 0
  let aborted: boolean = signal.aborted
  let concluded = false

​四个​游标​ + ​两条​状态​数组​：slots[i] ​是​第​ i ​个​调用​落定​的​ dispatch ​结果​，callSeqs[i] ​是​它​ tool/call ​事件​的​ seq（​结果​事件​用​ sourceEventSeqs ​引用​它​，​形成​日志​内​的​因果​配对​）。​三个​关键​闭包​：

  // `committed` advances only across contiguous model-order slots.
  const commitReady = async (): Promise<void> => {
    while (committed < group.length) {
      const slot = slots[committed]
      if (slot === undefined) break
      const call = group[committed]
      const result = await pipeline.complete(slot.exec, slot)
      settlement.commit(call!.block, result, callSeqs[committed])
      concluded ||= result.concludesTurn === true
      committed++
    }
  }

committed ​只​沿​连续​前缀​推进​：​就算​第​ 3 ​个​调用​先​落定​，​也​要​等​第​ 1、2 ​个​落定​并​完成​ pipeline.complete（​后置​策略​ + finalizeContent + ​广播​）​后​才​提交​ —— ​结果​顺序​永远​等于​模型​顺序​。

  const startCall = async (index: number): Promise<void> => {
    const call = group[index]!
    callSeqs[index] = settlement.start(call.block)   // ​追加​ tool/call ​事件​
    started++
    const prepared = await pipeline.prepare(call.exec)   // ​顺序​的​ pre-execute ​策略​
    throwSchedulerFailure()
    switch (prepared.kind) {
      case 'dispatch': {
        const promise = pipeline.dispatch(prepared.exec).then(
          (outcome) => { slots[index] = { ...outcome, exec: prepared.exec }; return index },
          (error: unknown) => { schedulerFailure ??= { error }; return index },
        )
        inFlight.set(index, promise)
        break
      }
      case 'post-result':
      case 'final-result':
        slots[index] = prepared   // ​拒绝​/​取消​/​管线​失败​：​无需​ dispatch
        break

prepare ​顺序​、dispatch ​并发​：pre-execute ​策略​（​含​审批​提示​）​一次​只​处理​一个​调用​，​避免​审批​弹窗​乱序​；​真正​跑​正文​的​ dispatch ​进​ inFlight ​池​。dispatch ​的​失败​不​抛出​，​而是​记进​ schedulerFailure（​第一个​错误​定案​），​让​排空​逻辑​接管​。

  const fillPool = async (): Promise<void> => {
    while (!aborted && nextToStart < group.length && inFlight.size < maxParallelToolCalls) {
      // Re-read later modes after ordered commits so registry changes can create a barrier.
      const nextCall = group[nextToStart]!
      if (nextToStart > 0 && mode === 'parallel'
        && pipeline.executionMode(nextCall.exec).kind !== 'parallel') break
      await startCall(nextToStart)
      nextToStart++
      throwSchedulerFailure()
      await commitReady()
      throwSchedulerFailure()
      if (signal.aborted) aborted = true
    }
  }

​滚动​池补位​前​重新​分类​下​一个​调用​：parallel ​组​里​如果​后面​的​调用​此刻​已​被​注册表​变化​（​或​分类器​输出​）​改成​ exclusive，​就​停止​补位​ —— ​剩余​调用​留给​外层​循环​在​池​排空​后​作为​新​屏障​运行​。​主​循环​：

  try {
    await fillPool()
    while (inFlight.size > 0) {
      const settledIndex = await Promise.race(inFlight.values())
      inFlight.delete(settledIndex)
      throwSchedulerFailure()
      await commitReady()
      throwSchedulerFailure()
      if (signal.aborted) aborted = true
      await fillPool()
    }
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    schedulerFailure ??= { error }
    await Promise.allSettled(inFlight.values())
    throw schedulerFailure.error
  }

  if (aborted) {
    // Started calls and accepted context settle first; every remaining model
    // call then receives an ordered synthetic result before the turn aborts.
    for (const call of group.slice(started)) settlement.skip(call.block)
    return { consumed: group.length, aborted: true, concluded }
  }

Promise.race(inFlight.values()) ​等​任意​一个​ dispatch ​落定​ → ​有序​提交​ → ​补位​ → ​循环​。abort ​不​抛出​：​已​启动​的​调用​排空​并​正常​落账​（​正文​ quiescence ​由​管线​保证​），​未​启动​的​记​ ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH ​合成​结果​，​返回​ aborted: true ​让​外层​跳过​后续​组​。​调度​器​失败​才​抛出​（​先​ Promise.allSettled ​排空​），​由​ executeToolBatch ​包​成​ ToolBatchExecutionError。

docs.title: 4. BatchSettlement — Session ​日志​与​结果​聚合
docs.text:
/** Collect committed results and optionally append their durable Session events. */
class BatchSettlement {
  private readonly results: ToolCallResult[] = []
  private readonly contexts: UserMessage[] = []

  constructor(private readonly input: ToolBatchInput) {}

  start(block: ToolCallBlock): SessionSeq | undefined {
    if (this.input.log === undefined) return undefined
    const { agent, log: { turn, step } } = this.input
    return agent!.session.append('tool/call', {
      turn, step, callId: block.id, name: block.name, arguments: block.arguments,
    }).seq
  }

  commit(block: ToolCallBlock, result: ToolExecutionResult, callSeq: SessionSeq | undefined): void {
    if (this.input.log !== undefined) {
      const { agent, log: { turn, step } } = this.input
      agent!.session.append('tool/result', {
        turn, step,
        message: createToolResultMessage({ callId: block.id, content: result.content, isError: result.isError }),
        ...result.error?.info ? { error: result.error.info } : {},
        ...result.meta !== undefined ? { meta: result.meta } : {},
      }, {
        surfaceOp: 'append',
        sourceEventSeqs: [callSeq!],
      })
    }
    this.results.push({ callId: block.id, result })
    this.contexts.push(...result.additionalContexts ?? [])
  }

  skip(block: ToolCallBlock): void {
    this.commit(block, {
      content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Error: tool call aborted before dispatch' }],
      isError: true,
      error: {
        message: 'tool call aborted before dispatch',
        info: { name: 'AbortError', code: TOOL_ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH },
      },
    }, this.start(block))
  }

  result(concluded = ...): ToolBatchResult {
    return { results: this.results, additionalContexts: this.contexts, concluded }
  }
}

log ​缺省​时​一切​照常​收集​，​只是​不写​根​事件​（​工具​自己​的​事件​仍​可用​ Session）。start/commit ​的​配对​：tool/call ​在​正文​启动​前落​账​（​重放时​ pending ​卡片​可​还原​），tool/result ​用​ sourceEventSeqs ​引用​它​的​ seq。​落账​的​展示​字段​是​ content、​结构化​ error.info ​和​ meta —— ​注意​没有​ value：​规范​值​是​执行期​本地​的​（​见​ contracts.md）。meta ​就是​ presentationMeta ​投影​出​的​卡片​元​数据​，​重​放​ UI ​靠​它​渲染​结构化​卡片​。skip ​补记​合成​取消​结果​（​先​ start ​再​ commit，​日志​依然​配对​完整​）。result() ​默认​从​已​收集​结果​里​推导​ concluded。

docs.title: 核心​类​与​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​签名​概要​ ​职责​ executeToolBatch() (input, pipeline, maxParallel) => Promise<ToolBatchResult> ​批次​入口​：​校验​、​计划​、​分组​循环​、​失败​包装​ runGroup() (pipeline, settlement, max, group, mode, signal) => Promise<GroupOutcome> ​一组​的​滚动​池​执行​与​有序​提交​ commitReady()（runGroup ​闭包​） () => Promise<void> ​沿​连续​前缀​做​ pipeline.complete + ​落账​ startCall()（runGroup ​闭包​） (index) => Promise<void> ​记​ tool/call → ​顺序​ prepare → ​并发​ dispatch fillPool()（runGroup ​闭包​） () => Promise<void> ​池补位​，​补位​前重​分类​，​可​形成​新​屏障​ BatchSettlement start/commit/skip/result Session ​事件​落账​ + ​结果​/​上下文​聚合​ parseArguments() (raw: string) => unknown ​空串​→{}，​畸形​ JSON→​原样​字符串​ PlannedCall / Slot / GroupOutcome ​内部结构​ ​计划​调用​ / ​落定​槽​ / ​组​结果

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• pipeline.ts：executeToolBatch ​的​第二​参数​；prepare/dispatch/complete/executionMode ​全部​来自​它​；​本​文件​末尾​被​ pipeline.ts re-export（export { executeToolBatch } from './batch.ts'）。
  • executor.ts：ToolBatchInput/ToolBatchResult/ToolCallResult ​定义​处​；ToolBatchExecutionError ​是​内部​失败​的​出口​。​内置​执行器​把​ maxParallel ​实现​为​读取​自己​当前​配置​的​函数​。
  • contracts.ts：TOOL_ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH ​用于​ skip ​的​合成​结果​。
  • dsh-llm ​的​ createToolResultMessage：​把​ content/isError ​装配成​ Session ​消息​。
  • dsh-session ​的​ SessionSeq：tool/call ​与​ tool/result ​的​因果​配对​。
  • agent loop：​消费​ ToolBatchResult，​把​ additionalContexts ​按​ FIFO ​追加​、​据​ concluded ​结束​ turn。

docs.title: 小结
docs.text: batch.ts ​的​全部​复杂度​服务​于​两条​不​变量​：​结果​与​日志​严格​按​模型​顺序​（committed ​只​沿​连续​前缀​推进​，tool/call→tool/result ​靠​ seq ​配对​），​每个​输入​调用​都​有​收场​（abort ​给​未​启动​调用​记​合成​结果​，​内部​失败​以​ partial ​保留​已落​账​部分​）。​在​这个​骨架​上​，exclusive ​屏障​与​ bounded ​滚动​池​实现​并发​安全​工具​的​重叠​执行​，​而​批次​中途​的​注册表​变化​通过​"​提交​后​再​分类​、​补位​前重​分类​"​即时​生效​ —— ​并发​是​工具​声明​的​特权​，​顺序​是​调度​器​保证​的​义务​。

docs.title: contracts.ts — ​工具​契约​类型
docs.text:
​工具​体系​的​全部​核心​类型​契约​

packages/core/tools/src/contracts.ts ​是​整个​工具​体系​的​"​类型​词典​"：​注册表​（index.ts）、​执行​管线​（pipeline.ts）、​批次​调度​（batch.ts）、​执行器​（executor.ts）​之间​交换​的​每​一个​值​都​在​这里​定义​。​文件​本身​几乎​没有​运行​时​逻辑​ —— ​只有​四个​错误​类​、​两个​取消​码​常量​和​保留​名​ run_code —— ​其余​全部​是​ interface / type。​读懂​这个​文件​，​后面​每个​文件​的​代码​都​是​这些​类型​的​运转​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
​类型​按​职责​分​四组​：

​组​ ​类型​ ​问答​ ​工具​定义​ ToolOutputDefinition、ToolDefinition、ToolResult、ToolActivationContext、ToolRegistrationOptions、ResolvedToolSet "​一个​工具​长​什么样​、​怎么​条件​启用​" ​执行​对象​ ToolExecutionToken、ToolExecutionInput、ToolExecution、ToolDispatchExecution、ToolRunContext、ToolExecutionMode "​一次​调用​在​管线​里​被​谁​拿​着​、​能​看见​什么​" ​结果​与​错误​ ToolExecutionSuccess/Failure/Result、ToolFailure、ToolErrorInfo、ToolNotFoundError、ToolOutputError、ToolActivationError、TOOL_ABORTED* "​一次​调用​如何​收场​" ​策略​ PreToolDecision、PostToolDecision、ToolGuard、ToolRestriction "​策略​插件​能​表达​什么​决定​"

docs.title: 1. ​保留​名​与​不​透明​ token
docs.text:
/** Reserved model-facing program transport name. */
export const RUN_CODE_NAME = 'run_code'
declare const toolExecutionTokenBrand: unique symbol

/** Opaque call identity that permits correlation without exposing mutable execution state. */
export type ToolExecutionToken = symbol & { readonly [toolExecutionTokenBrand]: true }

run_code ​是​ PTC ​模式​的​保留​传输​名​ —— ​全局​注册表​无条件​拒绝​把​它​注册​或​遮蔽​（​否则​部署​默认​态下​能​注册​的​名字​，​一挂​ PTC preset ​就​变成​冲突​）。ToolExecutionToken ​是​品牌化​ symbol（​符合​仓库​"​跨​边界​不​透明​ id ​必须​ branded"​的​约定​）：​它​的​值​即​身份​，​只​做​同一性​比较​。​执行器​把​它​发给​嵌套​调用​作为​ parent，​外部​世界​永远​拿​不到​活​的​执行​对象​。

docs.title: 2. ToolOutputDefinition：​规范​输出​的​声明
docs.text:
/** Tool-owned canonical output contract used after the body returns a JSON value. */
export interface ToolOutputDefinition {
  /** Raw supported JSON Schema enforced against every successful canonical value. */
  readonly schema: JsonSchemaNode
  /** Pure projection from validated arguments and value to Native/model content. */
  render(args: unknown, value: JsonValue): ContentBlock[]
  /** Pure replayable presentation projection for native and nested calls. */
  presentationMeta?(args: unknown, value: JsonValue): JsonValue
}

​工具​正文​返回​的​不是​模型​文本​，​而是​规范​值​（canonical value）：​一个​通过​ output.schema ​校验​的​无损​ JSON ​值​。render ​把​它​投影​成​模型​可见​/​落账​的​ ContentBlock[]；presentationMeta ​再​投影​一份​给​ UI ​卡片​用​的​ JSON ​元​数据​（​会​在​ tool/result / tool/ptc-dispatch ​事件​里​持久​化​，​让​重放时​ UI ​仍能​渲染​结构化​卡片​）。​三个​都​必须​是​纯​函数​。

docs.title: 3. ToolDefinition：​注册表​持有​的​完整​定义
docs.text:
/** A registered tool: its schema plus the execution function. */
export interface ToolDefinition extends ToolSchema {
  /** Mandatory canonical output declaration. */
  readonly output: ToolOutputDefinition
  /**
   * Run one accepted call and return only its canonical lossless-JSON value.
   * ...
   */
  execute(args: unknown, exec: ToolRunContext): Promise<unknown>
  projectContent?(exec: Readonly<ToolExecution>, result: Readonly<ToolExecutionResult>): ContentBlock[] | undefined
  finalizeContent?(exec: Readonly<ToolExecution>, result: Readonly<ToolExecutionResult>): ContentBlock[] | undefined
  timeoutMs?: number
  isConcurrencySafe?(args: unknown): boolean
  presentCall?(args: unknown): ToolCallView | undefined
  presentResult?(args: unknown, result: ToolResult): ToolResultView | undefined
}

​继承​自​ ToolSchema（​模型​可见​三件套​：name/description/parameters），​再​叠加​执行​侧字段​。​注意​几个​签名​细节​：

  • execute(args: unknown, ...) —— ​原始​定义​自己​校验​参数​；​第一​方​工具​走​ defineTool，​得到​类型化​的​ args ​并​在​进​正文​前​抛​ ToolArgsError（​见​ schema.md）。
  • projectContent ​在​ post-execute ​之前​安装​"​执行期​预备​内容​"；finalizeContent ​是​所有​策略​之后​的​最后​一英里​内容​变换​，​且​刻意​收​ ToolExecution（​而​非​类型化​ args）—— ​因为​非法​参数​、​管线​失败​这些​没有​合法​ args ​的​结果​也​会​流经​它​。
  • timeoutMs ​只是​声明​：registry ​从不​强制​，​需要​ dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy ​包装​插件​真正​执行​；​声明​它​等于​承诺​工具​正文​会​观察​ exec.signal ​达到​ quiescence。
  • isConcurrencySafe ​是​"​是否​可​与​兄弟​调用​重叠​"​的​纯​分类器​，​只有​精确​的​ true ​才​并行​，​未声明​/​抛错​/​返回​非​ true ​一律​ exclusive（fail-closed）。
  • presentCall/presentResult ​是​纯​展示​回调​，​可能​在​日志​重放时​被​调用​，​所以​只许​依赖​ args（​和​落账​的​ content/isError/meta）。

docs.title: 4. ​执行​对象​家族​：​谁​能​看见​什么
docs.text:
export interface ToolExecutionInput {
  readonly callId: ToolCallId
  readonly rootCallId?: ToolCallId
  readonly name: string
  /** Binding-time tool schema for a PTC inner call; frozen by its producer and never logged. */
  readonly schema?: ToolSchema
  readonly arguments: unknown
  readonly agent?: Agent
  readonly toolSet?: ResolvedToolSet
  readonly parent?: ToolExecutionToken
  /** Required caller-owned cancellation for this invocation. */
  readonly signal: AbortSignal
}

export interface ToolExecution extends ToolExecutionInput {
  readonly rootCallId: ToolCallId
  readonly token: ToolExecutionToken
}

export interface ToolDispatchExecution extends Omit<ToolExecution, 'signal'> {
  signal: AbortSignal
}

export interface ToolRunContext extends ToolExecution {
  deferContext(context: UserMessage): void
  concludeTurn(): void
}

​这是​一个​逐层​加​权限​的​四级​结构​：

  • ToolExecutionInput ​是​调度​器​提交​的​原料​：​调用​ id、​名字​、​解析​后​的​参数​、​可​选​ agent、step ​准入​ toolSet、​可​选​ parent（PTC ​子​调用​标记​ —— ​在​ PTC ​执行器​选中​时​，​没有​ parent ​的​模型​直连​调用​不许​执行​ native ​工具​名​，​会​在​策略​管线​前​被​拒成​ UNKNOWN_TOOL）、​以及​必填​的​调用​方​ signal。
  • ToolExecution = input + ​管线​分配​的​ token + ​解析​好​的​ rootCallId（​根​调用​ id，​嵌套​调用​继承​外层​）。​所有​ waterfall listener ​拿到​的​都​是​它​，​字段​全​ readonly。
  • ToolDispatchExecution ​是​ tools/execute ​包装者​看到​的​视图​：​唯一​可变​字段​是​ signal —— ​包装者​可以​给​下游​换​一个​信号​，​但​管线​会​在​进​正文​前​把​它​与​原始​调用​方​ signal ​融合​，​所以​替换​无法​甩掉​调用​方​取消​。
  • ToolRunContext ​是​工具​正文​拿到​的​运行​时​扩展​：deferContext() ​把​一条​ UserMessage ​上下文​挂到​自己​这次​执行​的​结果​上​（​复合​工具​回传​嵌套​分发​上下文​、​叶子​工具​注入​插件​来源​指令​的​通道​，loop ​会​在​ tool/result ​之后​追加​）；concludeTurn() ​把​本次​成功​结果​标记​为​终结​当前​ turn。

​还有​一个​调度​分类​：

export type ToolExecutionMode =
  | { kind: 'parallel' }
  | { kind: 'exclusive' }

docs.title: 5. ​结果​联合​与​错误​细节
docs.text:
/** Successful canonical tool execution, including its Native/model projection. */
export interface ToolExecutionSuccess {
  readonly isError: false
  /** Execution-local canonical value; deliberately omitted from durable events. */
  readonly value: JsonValue
  readonly content: ContentBlock[]
  readonly error?: never
  readonly meta?: JsonValue
  readonly additionalContexts?: UserMessage[]
  /** The agent loop stops after committing this successful result batch. */
  readonly concludesTurn?: true
}

/** Failed canonical tool execution; failures never carry a successful value. */
export interface ToolExecutionFailure {
  readonly isError: true
  readonly error: ToolFailure
  readonly value?: never
  readonly content: ContentBlock[]
  readonly meta?: JsonValue
  readonly additionalContexts?: UserMessage[]
  readonly concludesTurn?: never
}

export type ToolExecutionResult = ToolExecutionSuccess | ToolExecutionFailure

​判别式​联合​，isError ​收窄​，​两侧​用​ ?: never ​互斥​。​三个​关键点​：value ​是​执行期​本地​的​ —— loop ​落账​只​持久​化​ content/error/meta，​重放能​还原​ UI ​但​不能​还原​规范​值​；​失败​侧​永不​携带​成功​值​；concludesTurn ​只​存在​于​成功​侧​。

/** Structured error metadata for a failed tool call (alongside the model-facing text). */
export interface ToolErrorInfo {
  name: string
  code: string
  /** Optional raw user-facing detail; durable projections preserve it but model-facing content does not include it. */
  reason?: string
}

/** Canonical failure detail; internal routing information remains optional. */
export interface ToolFailure {
  message: string
  info?: ToolErrorInfo
}

​模型​看到​的​失败​永远​只是​ Error: <message> ​一行​文本​；ToolErrorInfo.reason ​是​给​持久​化​诊断​和​ UI ​看​的​原始​细节​，​不进​模型​内容​ —— ​这是​"​模型​可见​ ⟺ ​已落​账​"​与​"​用户​可见​可以​更​多​"​的​分界​。

docs.title: 6. ​决策​类型​与​单调​ guard
docs.text:
export type PreToolDecision =
  | { kind: 'allow' }
  | { kind: 'deny'; reason: string; info?: ToolErrorInfo }
  | { kind: 'cancel' }
  | { kind: 'ask'; reason?: string; displayReason?: { readonly en: string; readonly [locale: string]: string } }

export type PostToolDecision =
  | { kind: 'accept'; content?: ContentBlock[]; value?: never; additionalContexts?: UserMessage[] }
  | { kind: 'accept'; value: JsonValue; content?: never; additionalContexts?: UserMessage[] }
  | { kind: 'block'; feedback: ContentBlock[]; additionalContexts?: UserMessage[] }

export type ToolGuard = (execution: Readonly<ToolExecution>) => string | undefined

PreToolDecision ​的​四种​：allow ​放行​；deny ​带​模型​可见​ reason（​可附​结构化​ info）；cancel ​选择​"​规范​的​前​分发​取消​结果​"​而​不​呈现​策略​拒绝​；ask ​交给​审批​服务​，​只有​ allowed-once ​才​放行​，​其余​情况​一律​ deny。​没有​ rewrite —— ​参数​已​被​记录​与​呈现​，​改写​会​让​日志​、​审计​、UI ​和​实际​执行​四者​失配​。PostToolDecision ​的​ accept ​有​两个​互斥​形态​：​换​ content（​保住​规范​值​）​或换​ value（​会​被​重新​校验​并重​算​ content/meta），block ​则​把​纠错​反馈​变成​ isError。

ToolGuard ​返回​ string | undefined：​刻意​没有​ allow ​分支​ —— undefined ​表示​弃权​保留​上游​决定​，​返回​ reason ​只能​降低​权限​。​这​就是​"​单调​ deny"​的​类型​层​保证​：​无论​ guard ​以​什么​顺序​注册​，​后​注册​的​都​翻​不了​先​注册​的​拒绝​。

docs.title: 7. ​条件​激活​与​ restriction
docs.text:
export interface ToolActivationContext {
  readonly agent: Agent
  readonly modelSelection: Readonly<ModelSelection>
  readonly signal: AbortSignal
}

export interface ToolRegistrationOptions {
  readonly when?: (context: ToolActivationContext) => boolean | Promise<boolean>
}

export interface ResolvedToolSet {
  dispose(): void
  view(scope: ScopeKey | undefined): ReadonlyMap<string, ToolDefinition>
}

export interface ToolRestriction {
  readonly allow?: readonly string[]
  readonly deny?: readonly string[]
}

when ​收到​ step ​准备​时​捕获​的​ modelSelection（provider/model/reasoning effort），​同一个​ step ​的​所有​请求​尝试​共用​它​。ResolvedToolSet ​是​一次​ resolve() ​的​产物​：dispose() ​关闭​准入​，view(scope) ​按​当前​注册表​复核​后​给出​ admitted ​定义​。ToolRestriction ​只​作用​于​继承​的​全局​工具​，allow ​是​白名单​、deny ​是​黑名单​，​多条​ restriction ​取​交集​。

docs.title: 8. ​错误​类​与​取消​码
docs.text:
/** Canonical error code for cancellation after a tool body was invoked. */
export const TOOL_ABORTED = 'ABORTED'

/** Canonical error code for cancellation before a tool body was invoked. */
export const TOOL_ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH = 'ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH'

export class ToolNotFoundError extends HarnessError {
  constructor(toolName: string, reachableFrom?: string) {
    super(
      reachableFrom === undefined
        ? `unknown tool "${toolName}"`
        : `unknown tool "${toolName}": ${reachableFrom}`,
      'UNKNOWN_TOOL',
    )
    this.name = 'ToolNotFoundError'
  }
}

export class ToolOutputError extends HarnessError {
  readonly violations: string[]
  constructor(toolName: string, violations: string[]) {
    super(`tool "${toolName}" returned invalid output: ${violations.join('; ')}`, 'INVALID_TOOL_OUTPUT')
    ...
  }
}

​两个​取消​码​区分​"​正文​还​没​开始​就​被​取消​"​与​"​正文​已​启动​后​取消​替换​成功​结果​"—— ​调度​器​和​重放​逻辑​靠​它​分辨​该不该​把​未​启动​调用​记​成​合成​结果​。ToolNotFoundError ​继承​ HarnessError ​使​ UNKNOWN_TOOL ​与​工具​自身​错误​一样​可​路由​（​重试​/​沙箱​/​重​放​代码​可以​区分​）；reachableFrom ​参数​表达​一种​特殊​情形​：​名字​其实​可见​，​只是​呈现​层​禁止​模型​直连​（​比如​ PTC ​模式​下​ native ​工具​只能​被子​程序​调用​）。ToolActivationError（TOOL_ACTIVATION_FAILED）​在​前面​第​ 3 ​节​的​条件​激活​中​已经​出现​。

docs.title: 核心​类型​与​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​签名​概要​ ​职责​ RUN_CODE_NAME const 'run_code' PTC ​程序​传输​保留​名​，​注册​与​ restriction ​均​不可​点名​ ToolOutputDefinition { schema, render, presentationMeta? } ​规范​输出​声明​：​值​ schema + ​内容​渲染​ + UI ​元​数据​投影​ ToolDefinition ToolSchema & { output, execute, … } ​注册表​持有​的​完整​工具​定义​ ToolExecutionToken branded symbol ​调用​身份​ token，​值即​身份​，​仅作​同一性​比较​ ToolExecutionInput { callId, name, arguments, signal, … } ​管线​输入​：​身份​ + ​参数​ + ​必填​调用​方​取消​信号​ ToolExecution Input & { rootCallId, token } ​管线​内​只读​执行​对象​，waterfall ​共享​ ToolDispatchExecution Omit<ToolExecution,'signal'> & { signal } tools/execute ​包装者​视图​，​仅​ signal ​可换​ ToolRunContext ToolExecution & { deferContext, concludeTurn } ​工具​正文​运行​时​上下文​：​延迟​上下文​与​终结​ turn ToolExecutionMode 'parallel' \| 'exclusive' ​判别​联合​ ​调度​分类​：​重叠​ or ​屏障​ ToolExecutionResult Success \| Failure ​判别​联合​ ​一次​调用​的​最终​收场​；value ​只​在​执行期​存在​ ToolFailure / ToolErrorInfo { message, info? } / { name, code, reason? } ​模型​可见​消息​ + ​结构化​诊断​（reason ​不进​模型​内容​） PreToolDecision allow/deny/cancel/ask ​联合​ pre-execute ​的​四种​决定​，​无​ rewrite PostToolDecision accept(content ​或​ value)/block ​联合​ post-execute ​的​三种​决定​，content ​与​ value ​互斥​ ToolGuard (exec) => string \| undefined ​单调​ guard：​只能​ deny，​不能​ allow ToolRestriction { allow?, deny? } ​继承​全局​工具​的​ per-scope ​过滤​，​多条​取​交集​ ToolActivationContext / ToolRegistrationOptions / ResolvedToolSet ​条件​激活​三件套​ step ​级​工具​准入​ ToolNotFoundError HarnessError('UNKNOWN_TOOL') ​未知​/​不可​直连​工具​，​可​路由​的​结构化​失败​ ToolOutputError HarnessError('INVALID_TOOL_OUTPUT') ​正文​值​或​渲染​违反​ output schema ToolActivationError HarnessError('TOOL_ACTIVATION_FAILED') when ​条件​抛错​（​非​普通​不可​用​） TOOL_ABORTED / TOOL_ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH ​错误码​常量​ ​正文​后​取消​ / ​正文​前​取消

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• index.ts ​的​ ToolsService ​消费​ ToolDefinition/ToolRestriction/ToolGuard/ResolvedToolSet，​是​这些​类型​的​唯一​持有者​。
  • pipeline.ts ​消费​全部​执行​对象​与​决策​类型​，​并​负责​把​任意​抛出​值​规范​成​ ToolExecutionResult。
  • executor.ts ​的​批次​类型​引用​ ToolExecutionResult；batch.ts ​调度​ ToolExecutionInput ​并​消费​ TOOL_ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH ​合成​跳过​结果​。
  • schema.ts ​的​ defineTool ​产出​ ToolDefinition；presentation.ts ​的​ ToolCallView/ToolResultView ​是​ presentCall/presentResult ​的​返回​类型​。
  • events.ts ​把​决策​类型​作为​三段​ waterfall ​的​返回​契约​。

docs.title: 小结
docs.text: contracts.ts ​用​一个​文件​锁定​了​工具​体系​的​全部​词汇​：​定义​（​模型​可见​ schema + ​规范​输出​ + ​执行​/​策略​/​呈现​回调​）、​执行​对象​（​四级​只读​递进​，​唯一​可变​点​是​ around ​包装​的​ signal）、​结果​（​成功​携带​执行期​本地​规范​值​、​失败​携带​结构化​但​不进​模型​内容​的​错误​细节​）、​决定​（pre ​无​ rewrite、post ​内容​与值​互斥​、guard ​单调​）。​所有​后续​文件​都​是​把​这套​类型​在​运行​时​安全​地​兑现​ —— ​管线​负责​"​每个​抛出​都​变成​合法​的​ ToolExecutionResult"，​类型​负责​"​每个​越权​操作​在​编译​期​就​写​不​出来​"。

docs.title: events.ts — ​管线​事件
docs.text:
​工具​执行​策略​的​五个​共享​事件​

packages/core/tools/src/events.ts ​只有​ 58 ​行​，​却是​整个​工具​管线​的​"​插头​面板​"：​它​通过​ Cordis ​的​声明​合并​把​ 5 ​个​事件​挂进​全局​ Events ​接口​ —— ​三段​ waterfall（tools/pre-execute、tools/execute、tools/post-execute）​和​两个​ emit（tools/result、tools/change）。​文件​里​没有​任何​实现​：​管线​（pipeline.ts）​负责​触发​，​插件​负责​监听​。​类型​上​的​一个​贯穿​设计​是​ this: Scoped<ToolsService> —— ​监听器​通过​ dsh-scope ​的​作用域​过滤​分发​，agent-scoped ​的​ listener ​只​收到​那个​ agent ​的​调用​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 事件​ ​模式​ ​签名​要点​ ​触发​位置​ tools/pre-execute waterfall (exec, next) => PreToolDecision ​管线​ prepare()，​参数​冻结​后​、guard ​前​ tools/execute waterfall (exec: ToolDispatchExecution, next) => ToolExecutionResult ​管线​ dispatch()，​包住​工具​正文​ tools/post-execute waterfall (exec, result, next) => PostToolDecision ​管线​ complete()，​正文​结果​规范化​后​ tools/result emit (exec, result) => undefined ​管线​ finish()，​结果​冻结​后​ tools/change emit () => void ​注册表​条目​增删​（ScopedLayers ​回调​）

docs.title: 1. ​声明​合并​的​骨架
docs.text:
declare module '@deepseek-ai/cordis' {
  interface Events {
    /**
     * Allow, deny, cancel, or ask before dispatch. `next()` delegates to allow;
     * ...
     * @param exec - the pending call (name, parsed arguments, caller agent).
     * @mode waterfall
     */
    'tools/pre-execute'(this: Scoped<ToolsService>, exec: ToolExecution, next: () => Promise<PreToolDecision>): Promise<PreToolDecision>

​全部​事件​都​长​在​ @deepseek-ai/cordis ​的​ Events ​接口​上​（typed events use declaration merging）。​每个​ JSDoc ​都​带​ @mode（waterfall / emit）​和​ @param —— ​这是​仓库​对​事件​文档​的​硬性​要求​。this: Scoped<ToolsService> ​把​作用域​过滤​语义​写​进​类型​：​监听器​注册​在​哪个​ scope，​就​只​看到​哪个​ agent ​的​调用​（tools/change ​是​唯一​无​参数​、​无​过滤​的​例外​）。

docs.title: 2. tools/pre-execute — ​可​重排​的​准入​门
docs.text:
'tools/pre-execute'(this: Scoped<ToolsService>, exec: ToolExecution, next: () => Promise<PreToolDecision>): Promise<PreToolDecision>

JSDoc ​契约​的​要点​：

  • next() ​委托​为​ allow —— ​这是​ waterfall ​语义​：​不​拦截​就​调用​ next() ​把​决定权​交给​下​一个​ listener，​全部​放行​则​默认​ allow；
  • ​返回​ { kind: 'deny' } ​短路​整条​链​，reason ​会​变成​模型​可见​的​ Error: <reason>，​可​选​ info ​附带​结构化​错误​；
  • ​返回​ { kind: 'cancel' } ​选择​规范​的​前​分发​取消​结果​（ABORTED_BEFORE_DISPATCH），​不​呈现​策略​拒绝​；
  • ​返回​ { kind: 'ask' } ​交给​审批​ seam（ctx.approval）：​只有​ allowed-once ​放行​，​审批​服务​缺失​、​无​ agent ​可​路由​、​用户​拒绝​/​取消​/​通道​不可​用​都​退化​为​ deny；
  • ​异步​ listener ​必须​观察​ exec.signal；​管线​在​它们​落定​后会​重查​取消​，​但​从不​抛弃​它们​的​ promise；
  • exec ​是​冻结​参数​后​的​只读​ ToolExecution —— ​参数​改写​被​刻意​排除​（​日志​、​审计​、UI ​与​实际​执行​必须​一致​）。

​审批​挂​在​哪​一段​：​就​在​这​一段​。pipeline.ts ​的​ prepare() ​跑​完​这个​ waterfall ​后​，​若​决定​是​ ask，​会调​ serviceAsk() ​走​ ctx.approval.request()，​映射​回​ allow/deny，​然后​才查​ guard（​见​下​）。

docs.title: 3. tools/execute — around ​包装​（​唯一​能换​ signal ​的​一段​）
docs.text:
'tools/execute'(this: Scoped<ToolsService>, exec: ToolDispatchExecution, next: () => Promise<ToolExecutionResult>): Promise<ToolExecutionResult>

​这是​三段​中​唯一​拿到​ ToolDispatchExecution ​的​一段​：​包装者​可以​替换​ exec.signal（​比如​超时​插件​给​下游​一个​限时信​号​），​但​身份​字​段​（callId/token/args ​等​）​不可​变​。next() ​直接​返回​规范化​的​ ToolExecutionResult，​包装者​可以​透传​、​替换​或​据此​重试​。​两个​安全阀​保证​"​替换​无法​甩掉​调用​方​取消​"：

  1. ​管线​的​ dispatchToolBody() ​把​原始​调用​方​ signal ​与​包装者​替换​的​ signal ​融合​后​再​交给​工具​正文​；
  2. ​包装者​自己​仍须​恢复​ signal ​并​等​自己​的​工作​ quiescence。

​超时​挂​哪​一段​：@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy ​就是​一个​ tools/execute wrapper —— ​这​也​解释​了​ ToolDefinition.timeoutMs ​为何​只是​声明​：registry ​不​强制​，​强制​逻辑​属于​这个​可​选​包装​。

docs.title: 4. tools/post-execute — ​结果​的​检查站
docs.text:
'tools/post-execute'(this: Scoped<ToolsService>, exec: ToolExecution, result: Readonly<ToolExecutionResult>, next: () => Promise<PostToolDecision>): Promise<PostToolDecision>

​拿到​的​是​规范化​后​的​ dispatch ​结果​ —— ​注意​"​工具​抛错​也​算​跑​完​了​"：thrown tools still reach this waterfall as errors，​所以​策略​插件​看到​的​结果​全集​与​模型​将​看到​的​一致​。listener ​可以​：

  • next() ​原样​接受​；
  • ​返回​ accept（​可换​ content ​或​ value，​二选​一​；​可附​ additionalContexts ​注入​下​一条​用户​消息​）；
  • ​返回​ block：​把​纠错​ feedback ​变成​ isError ​结果​，feedback ​文本​成为​ error.message。

​异步​ listener ​同样​必须​观察​ exec.signal；​落定​后​若​调用​方已​取消​，​管线​只​把​成功​的​ accepted ​结果​替换成​取消​结果​（​错误​结果​保留​更​具体​的​失败​身份​），​替换成​哪个​取消​码​取决于​正文​是否​已​启动​。

docs.title: 5. tools/result — ​只读​终点
docs.text:
/**
 * Observe the frozen, lossless-JSON final outcome. Listener failures are contained.
 * Scope-filtered dispatch (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope`): keyed by `exec.agent`.
 * @param exec - the execution object that traversed the pipeline.
 * @param result - a deep-frozen snapshot of the final returned result.
 * @mode emit
 */
'tools/result'(this: Scoped<ToolsService>, exec: Readonly<ToolExecution>, result: Readonly<ToolExecutionResult>): undefined

emit ​模式​、​没有​ next、​观察者​无法​改变​结果​ —— ​管线​在​触发​前​把​执行​对象​和​结果​都​ Object.freeze，​观察者​抛错​或​返回​被​拒绝​的​ promise ​只会​被​ ctx.logger.warn ​记录​，​不会​污染​结果​。​这是​遥测​/​审计​/​计费​类​插件​的​挂点​。​作用域​按​ exec.agent ​过滤​。

docs.title: 6. tools/change — ​注册表​变更​通知
docs.text:
/**
 * A tool was registered or unregistered, or a scoped restriction changed.
 * Unfiltered registry notification: scoped listeners receive changes from every
 * scope because a global contribution can affect every agent's next assembly.
 * @mode emit
 */
'tools/change'(): void

​无​参数​、​不​过滤​作用域​：scoped listener ​也​会​收到​所有​ scope ​的​变化​ —— ​因为​一个​全局​注册​可能​影响​任何​ agent ​的​下​一次​提示​词​组装​。ToolsService ​构造​ ScopedLayers ​时​把​ () => this.ctx.emit('tools/change') ​作为​层​变化​回调​传入​，​所以​工具​注册​/​反​注册​、restriction ​增删​都​会​触发​。​典型​消费者​是​提示​词​前缀​缓存​失效​逻辑​。​注意​：​执行器​的​注册​与​卸载​不​触发​它​（​提示​词​组装​与​批次​在​运行​时​各自​解析​当前​执行器​）。

docs.title: 核心​类​与​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​签名​概要​ ​职责​ tools/pre-execute waterfall (exec, next) => PreToolDecision ​准入​门​：allow/deny/cancel/ask；​审批​策略​挂点​ tools/execute waterfall (exec: ToolDispatchExecution, next) => ToolExecutionResult around ​包装​：​超时​/​重试​/​指标​；​唯一​可换​ signal tools/post-execute waterfall (exec, result, next) => PostToolDecision ​结果​检查站​：accept/replace/block + ​附加​上下文​ tools/result emit (exec, result) => undefined ​冻结​结果​的​只读​观察​，​观察者​失败​被​包容​ tools/change emit () => void ​注册表​/​限制​变化​通知​，​无​作用域​过滤

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• contracts.ts ​提供​全部​载荷​类型​（ToolExecution、ToolDispatchExecution、ToolExecutionResult、PreToolDecision、PostToolDecision）。
  • pipeline.ts ​是​唯一​的​触发​方​：prepare() ​触发​ pre-execute，dispatch() ​触发​ execute，complete() → postExecute() ​触发​ post-execute，finish() → notifyResult() ​触发​ result。
  • index.ts ​是​ tools/change ​的​触发​方​（​经​ ScopedLayers ​回调​）​与​ Scoped<ToolsService> ​的​ this ​提供​方​。
  • guard ​不​在​这里​：ctx.tools.guard() ​是​普通​函数​注册​（GuardLayer），​管线​在​ pre-execute ​决议​之后​调​ checkGuards()，​这是​"​审批​可​重排​、owner ​策略​不可​重排​"​的​分层​设计​。
  • dsh-scope ​提供​作用域​过滤​分发​（Scoped<T>），tool-executor-ptc ​另有​ tools/ptc-dispatch-log waterfall（​声明​在​ PTC ​包​，​改写​的​只是​持久​化​日志​副本​）。

docs.title: 小结
docs.text: events.ts ​把​工具​执行​的​全部​扩展​点​收敛​成​ 5 ​个​有​严格​签名​契约​的​事件​：​前置​（allow/deny/cancel/ask，​审批​在​这​）、around（​换​ signal ​的​唯一​位置​，​超时​在​这​）、​后置​（​改​结果​/​阻断​/​注入​上下文​）、​终点​（​只读​冻结​结果​）、​注册表​（​变化​广播​）。​三段​ waterfall ​共享​同一个​ Cordis ​惯例​ —— ​调​ next() ​表示​放行​默认​，​返回​ decision ​表示​短路​ —— ​而​ guard ​刻意​不​走​事件​系统​，​用​单调​函数​补​上​"​绝不​可​翻案​的​拒绝​"。​理解​这​ 5 ​个​签名​，​就​理解​了​所有​工具​策略​插件​的​能力​边界​。

docs.title: executor.ts — ​执行器​接口
docs.text:
​执行器​契约​与​原始​批次​输入​/​输出​

packages/core/tools/src/executor.ts ​定义​"​谁​来​执行​工具​"​的​契约​。ToolsService（​注册表​）​只​回答​"​有​哪些​工具​、​谁​有​资格​调用​"；​真正​把​一批​模型​ tool-call ​变成​一批​结果​的​是​ ToolExecutor —— ​一个​由​独立​插件​实现​的​接口​，​内置​实现​是​ dsh-tool-executor-native（​原生​ function-calling）​和​ dsh-tool-executor-ptc（run_code ​程序​模式​），​两者​都​把​单次​调用​委托​回​本​模块​下层​的​共享​管线​。​本​文件​还​定义​批次​级​数据结构​（ToolBatchInput/ToolBatchResult）​和​两个​批次​级​错误​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text: 类型​/​类​ ​职责​ ToolModelInput ​执行器​对​提示​词​组装​的​产出​：schemas + knownNames ToolPromptSection ​执行器​自带​的​提示​词​段落​（​随​执行器​注册​/​卸载​） ToolBatchInput ​原始​批次​：calls、signal、​并发​覆盖​、agent、step ​准入​、​日志​ step ToolCallResult / ToolBatchResult ​按​ callId ​关联​的​结果​ + ​延迟​上下文​ + ​是否​终结​ turn ToolExecutor ​执行器​接口​：describe() + execute()，​仅​两个​方法​ ToolBatchExecutionError ​批次​内部​失败​：​拒绝​前先​排空​，​携带​已落​账​的​部分​结果​ ToolExecutorUnavailableError ​选中​执行器​缺失​/​已​卸载​的​结构化​错误

docs.title: 1. ToolModelInput ​与​ ToolPromptSection
docs.text:
/** Model-call schemas produced by an executor. */
export type ToolModelInput = Pick<ToolProviderResult, 'schemas' | 'knownNames'>

/** Executor-owned guidance registered through the system-prompt section API. */
export interface ToolPromptSection extends Pick<PromptSection, 'name' | 'order' | 'interpolate'> {
  /** Static guidance or text generated from this step's visible capability definitions. */
  readonly text: string | ((tools: readonly ToolDefinition[]) => string)
}

describe(tools) ​的​返回值​就是​这​两样​：​模型​请求​里​的​ schemas（native ​模式​是​每个​工具​一条​，PTC ​模式​只有​ run_code ​一条​）​和​ knownNames（​提示​词里​工具​顺序​校验​用​的​名字​集合​）。ToolPromptSection ​允许​执行器​往​ system prompt ​贡献​自己​的​使用指南​：text ​可以​是​静态​字符串​，​也​可以​是​根据​本​ step ​可见​工具​定义​动态​生成​的​函数​ —— ​例如​ PTC ​执行器​用​它​生成​ SDK API ​文档​。​这些​段落​随​ setExecutor() ​注册​、​随​执行器​卸载​销毁​，​且​渲染​时会​先​检查​"​当前​ scope ​选中​的​执行器​还​是不是​我​"，​不是​则​渲染​空串​。

docs.title: 2. ToolBatchInput — ​一批​原始​调用
docs.text:
/** Raw model calls, with optional Agent ownership and model-step logging. */
export interface ToolBatchInput {
  readonly calls: readonly ToolCallBlock[]
  readonly signal: AbortSignal
  /**
   * Positive integer overriding the executor's concurrency limit for this batch.
   * Applies to concurrency-safe root calls; program subcall limits remain separate.
   * Undefined uses the executor's configured limit.
   */
  readonly maxParallelToolCalls?: number
  readonly agent?: Agent
  readonly toolSet?: ResolvedToolSet
  readonly log?: {
    readonly turn: number
    readonly step: number
  }
}

​五个​字段​的​语义​边界​值得​逐一​记牢​：

  • calls ​是​模型​消息​里​的​原始​ ToolCallBlock[]（​含未​解析​的​ JSON ​字符串​参数​）—— ​参数​解析​是​执行器​的​职责​（​共享​批次​入口​会​宽容​解析​，​见​ batch.md）。
  • agent ​缺省​ = ​服务​级​独立​调用​（​无​ scope、​无​ Session）；​有​ agent ​但​无​ log = ​程序化​调用​（​初始化​ hook ​等​）：​仍然​供给​工具​ scope ​与​执行​上下文​，​但​不​产生​根​ tool/call / tool/result ​事件​。
  • log ​指向​已​提交​的​模型​ step（turn/step ​编号​），​要求​ agent ​同时​存在​；​有​它​才​写​根​调用​/​结果​事件​。
  • toolSet ​是​本​ step ​的​ ResolvedToolSet ​准入​，​覆盖​批次​内​每​一个​调用​（​含​ PTC ​程序​子​调用​）。
  • maxParallelToolCalls ​是​批​次数​覆盖​，​只​作用​于​并发​安全​的​根​调用​；PTC ​程序​的​子​调用​并发​是​执行器​自己​的​另​一套​配置​。

docs.title: 3. ToolBatchResult — ​模型​序​的​收场
docs.text:
/** One settled result correlated with its original model call. */
export interface ToolCallResult {
  readonly callId: ToolCallId
  readonly result: ToolExecutionResult
}

/** Model-ordered outcomes and context accepted for the next step. */
export interface ToolBatchResult {
  readonly results: readonly ToolCallResult[]
  readonly additionalContexts: readonly UserMessage[]
  readonly concluded: boolean
}

​三条​铁律​写​在​ ToolExecutor.execute ​的​ JSDoc ​里​：​结果​必须​按​输入​顺序​、​每个​输入​调用​恰​一条​（abort ​时​被​跳​过​的​调用​也​要​有​合成​结果​）；​已​启动​的​工作​未​ quiescence ​前​绝不​落定​；additionalContexts ​是​本​批次​收集​到​的​延迟​上下文​（​工具​正文​ deferContext、post-execute ​决定​注入​的​），agent loop ​会​把​它们​按​ FIFO ​追加​到​已​记录​的​工具​结果​之后​。concluded ​在​任一​成功​结果​携带​ concludesTurn ​时为​ true，loop ​据此​结束​当前​ turn。

docs.title: 4. ToolExecutor — ​只有​两个​方法​的​插件​契约
docs.text:
/** A plugin owns argument parsing, dispatch, scheduling, cancellation, and logging. */
export interface ToolExecutor {
  readonly sections?: readonly ToolPromptSection[]
  describe(tools: readonly ToolDefinition[]): ToolModelInput
  execute(input: ToolBatchInput): Promise<ToolBatchResult>
}

​注释​第一行​就是​分工​宣言​：​一个​执行器​插件​全权​拥有​参数​解析​、​分发​、​调度​、​取消​与​日志​。registry ​对​执行器​的​最低​要求​只有​两个​方法​ —— ​自定义​执行器​可以​实现​完全​自己​的​执行​方式​（​甚至​不用​共享​管线​）。​内置​执行器​选择​复用​ ToolExecutionPipeline + executeToolBatch，​所以​它们​天然​获得​三段​ waterfall、guard、​协作​取消​与​统一​日志​（​这​正是​ pipeline.md ​与​ batch.md ​的​内容​）。

​失败​契约​同样​在​ JSDoc ​里​：​内部​失败​必须​先​排空​所有​已​启动​的​工作​，​然后​以​ ToolBatchExecutionError ​拒绝​并​保留​已落​账​的​结果​与​上下文​ —— ​调用​方​（agent loop）​据此​停下​依赖​工作​、​补记​缺失​的​日志​结果​。

docs.title: 5. ​两个​批次​级​错误
docs.text:
/** A drained batch failed internally; only the included results are committed. */
export class ToolBatchExecutionError extends Error {
  constructor(cause: unknown, readonly partial: ToolBatchResult) {
    super('Tool batch execution failed', { cause })
    this.name = 'ToolBatchExecutionError'
  }
}

/** The selected provider is missing or unloaded; another provider must not take its calls. */
export class ToolExecutorUnavailableError extends HarnessError {
  constructor() {
    super('The selected tool executor is unavailable. Load an executor in this composition before running the agent.', 'TOOL_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE')
    this.name = 'ToolExecutorUnavailableError'
  }
}

​前者​是​普通​ Error ​子类​（​批次​内部​失败​属于​实现​ bug，​不是​可​路由​的​业务​失败​），​关键​是​ partial：​排空​后​已​确定​的​那​部分​结果​不会​丢​。​后者​继承​ HarnessError、code TOOL_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE：selectExecutor() ​找​不到​可用​执行器​（​没挂​执行器​插件​，​或​挂​了​但​已​卸载​）​时​抛出​ —— ​错误​消息​明确​指向​修复​方式​（​在​当前​组合​里​加载​一个​执行器​）。registry ​卸载​执行器​时​保留​空​记录​，​正是​为了​让​这个​错误​而​不是​"​静默​换​执行器​"​发生​。

docs.title: 核心​类型​与​函数
docs.text: 名称​ ​签名​概要​ ​职责​ ToolModelInput Pick<ToolProviderResult, 'schemas' \| 'knownNames'> describe() ​产出​，​进入​提示​词​组装​ ToolPromptSection PromptSection ​字​段​ + text ​执行器​自有​的​提示​词​段落​，​可​按​可见​工具​动态​生成​ ToolBatchInput { calls, signal, maxParallelToolCalls?, agent?, toolSet?, log? } ​原始​批次​输入​；agent/log/toolSet ​三级​可​选​语义​ ToolCallResult { callId, result } ​单条​结果​与​原始​调用​的​关联​ ToolBatchResult { results, additionalContexts, concluded } ​模型​序​收场​ + ​延迟​上下文​ + ​终结​标记​ ToolExecutor { sections?, describe(), execute() } ​执行器​契约​：​解析​/​分发​/​调度​/​取消​/​日志​全归​插件​ ToolBatchExecutionError Error & { partial: ToolBatchResult } ​排空​后​拒绝​，​保留​部分​已落​账​结果​ ToolExecutorUnavailableError HarnessError('TOOL_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE') ​选中​执行器​缺失​/​卸载​，​新​批次​拒绝

docs.title: 与​其他​模块​的​关系
docs.text:
• index.ts ​的​ ToolsService.setExecutor() ​存​ ToolExecutor、selectExecutor() ​找​它​、execute() ​把​ ToolBatchInput ​转发给​它​；ToolExecutorUnavailableError ​由​ selectExecutor ​抛出​。
  • pipeline.ts ​与​ batch.ts ​是​内置​执行器​的​"​内部​零件​"：ToolExecutor ​的​ JSDoc ​逐条​对应​ executeToolBatch(input, pipeline, maxParallel) ​的​行为​（​顺序​结果​、abort ​合成​跳过​、​排空​后​拒绝​、maxParallelToolCalls ​优先​于​执行器​配置​）。
  • contracts.ts ​提供​ ToolDefinition（describe ​的​输入​）​与​ ToolExecutionResult（​每条​结果​的​类型​）。
  • ​上游​包​：dsh-tool-executor-native、dsh-tool-executor-ptc ​是​两个​内置​实现​；dsh-system-prompt ​的​ PromptSection ​被​ ToolPromptSection ​复用​；dsh-llm ​提供​ ToolCallBlock/ToolCallId。​执行器​选择​与​两种​内置​形态​的​对照​见​ executors ​章节​。

docs.title: 小结
docs.text: executor.ts ​把​"​注册表​知道​什么​"​与​"​执行器​做​什么​"​切成​一条​清晰​的​缝​：​注册表​交付​原始​批次​（​模型​给​什么​就​传​什么​，​外加​ scope、​准入​、​日志​位置​与​并发​覆盖​），​执行器​交回​模型​序​的​完整​结果​（​一个​调用​都​不能​少​，​跳过​的​给​合成​结果​，​排空​才​落定​）。​契约​只有​两个​方法​，​因此​换​一种​模型​交互​形态​（​原生​ function calling、PTC ​程序​、​甚至​完全​自定义​）​不​需要​动​注册表​一行​代码​；​而​内置​执行器​复用​共享​管线​，​换来​的​则​是​统一​的​三段​策略​、​取消​与​日志​语义​。

docs.title: json-schema.ts — JSON Schema ​子集
docs.text:
​受​支持​ JSON Schema ​子集​的​断言​与值​校验​

packages/core/tools/src/json-schema.ts ​是​整个​工具​体系​的​校验​底座​：​它​定义​wire ​级​的​原始​ JSON Schema ​节点​（JsonSchemaNode）—— ​与子​代理​、​工作​流​、MCP、PTC ​共享​的​受约束​子集​ —— ​并​提供​两个​方向​的​能力​：schema ​侧​（assertSupportedJsonSchema ​拒绝​子集​之外​的​任何​东西​）​和​值侧​（validateJsonSchemaValue ​对​任意​候选​值​返回​路径​限定​的​ violations）。schema.md ​的​作者​ DSL ​编译​产物​最终​都​落到​这里​校验​。

docs.title: 文件​概览
docs.text:
成员​ ​职责​ JsonSchemaNode / JsonSchemaType / JsonSchemaScalar / ObjectJsonSchema ​子集​的​ wire ​级​类型​ JsonSchemaError schema ​越界​的​结构化​错误​（UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA，​收集​全部​违规​路径​） assertSupportedJsonSchema() / assertObjectJsonSchema() schema ​断言​：​子集​ / ​子集​+​对象​根​ validateJsonSchemaValue() ​值​校验​：​显式​帧​迭代​，​对​任意​值全​容错​ isPlainJsonRecord / isPlainJsonArray / isJsonSchemaRecord realm ​无关​的​普通​对象​/​稠密​数组​判定​

​子集​本身​只有​：​单一​ type、​对象​ properties/required/​布尔​ additionalProperties、​数组​ items、​类型​正确​的​标量​ enum/const、exact-one oneOf、​四个​注解​键​（description/title/default/examples）。​不​支持​的​关键词​拒绝​而​不是​忽略​ —— ​被​"​接受​但​不​强制​"​的​约束​比​被​拒绝​更​危险​。

docs.title: 1. wire ​级​节点​类型
docs.text:
/** Single-type keywords accepted by the enforced subset. */
export type JsonSchemaType = 'object' | 'array' | 'string' | 'number' | 'integer' | 'boolean' | 'null'

/**
 * One raw JSON Schema node in the enforced subset. The optional fields express
 * the external wire schema; {@link assertSupportedJsonSchema} rejects invalid
 * combinations before a caller treats the node as trusted.
 */
export interface JsonSchemaNode {
  /** Omit with no constraints for any JSON value, or use `oneOf`. */
  type?: JsonSchemaType
  /** Exactly one branch must validate; at least two branches are required. */
  oneOf?: JsonSchemaNode[]
  properties?: Record<string, JsonSchemaNode>
  /** Required property names; each must appear in `properties`. */
  required?: string[]
  /** `false` rejects undeclared keys; absent/`true` follows JSON Schema's open default. */
  additionalProperties?: boolean
  /** Item schema (`type: 'array'` only); absent accepts any JSON item. */
  items?: JsonSchemaNode
  enum?: JsonSchemaScalar[]
  const?: JsonSchemaScalar
  description?: string
  title?: string
  default?: JsonValue
  examples?: JsonValue
}

type ​与​ oneOf ​互斥​；​不写​ type ​也​不​写​ oneOf ​的​节点​是​注解​节点​，​含义​是​"​任意​无损​ JSON"（​作者​ DSL ​的​ type: 'json' ​编译成​它​）。additionalProperties ​缺省​或​ true ​都​按​ JSON Schema ​的​开放​默认​处理​。

docs.title: 2. ​结构化​错误​：​收集​全部​违规​路径
docs.text:
export class JsonSchemaError extends HarnessError {
  /** Individual schema violations in walk order. */
  readonly violations: string[]

  constructor(violations: string[]) {
    super(`unsupported JSON schema: ${violations.join('; ')}`, 'UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA')
    this.name = 'JsonSchemaError'
    this.violations = violations
  }
}

​错误​消息​把​所有​越界​路径​一次​报全​（​不是​遇到​第一个​就​停​）—— ​作者​修​一轮​就​能​修​完​，​而​不是​改​一个​错​再​发现​下​一个​。

docs.title: 3. Realm ​无关​的​普通​值​判定
docs.text:
/* jscpd:ignore-start -- this realm boundary mirrors the session-owned lossless-JSON intrinsic test */
/** Whether a realm-owned intrinsic prototype is backed by its native constructor. */
function hasIntrinsicConstructor(prototype: object, name: 'Array' | 'Object'): boolean {
  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(prototype, 'constructor')
  const constructor: unknown = descriptor?.value
  if (typeof constructor !== 'function') return false
  try {
    return constructor.name === name
      && constructor.prototype === prototype
      && Function.prototype.toString.call(constructor) === `function ${name}() { [native code] }`
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

/**
 * Test for a realm-agnostic plain JSON record without accepting arrays or exotic objects.
 */
export function isPlainJsonRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false
  try {
    const prototype: unknown = Object.getPrototypeOf(value)
    return prototype === null
      || typeof prototype === 'object' && isIntrinsicObjectPrototype(prototype)
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

/** Test for a dense ordinary array with no JSON-invisible decorations. */
export function isPlainJsonArray(value: unknown): value is unknown[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return false
  try {
    if (!hasPlainArrayPrototype(value) || Reflect.ownKeys(value).length !== value.length + 1) return false
    for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index++) {
      if (!Object.hasOwn(value, index)) return false
    }
    return true
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

​为什么​这么​较真​？​工具​ schema ​和​值​可能​来自​另​一个​ JavaScript realm（worker、vm、​测试​框架​的​沙箱​）—— ​跨​ realm ​的​ instanceof Array ​会​失败​，​普通​ typeof ​检查​又​挡不住​带​私有​字段​的​ exotic ​对象​。​这里​的​判定​改为​检查​原型​链​是否是​本征​构造函数​ backing ​的​（​构造函数​名​ + ​原型​同一性​ + native code ​源码​三重​验证​），​数组​还​要求​稠密​且​无​额外​自有​键​（Reflect.ownKeys ​长度​恰好​ = length + 1）。isJsonSchemaRecord ​在​此​之上​再​要求​"​只有​可​枚举​的​自有​字符串​键​"—— symbol ​键​、​不可枚举​键​都​会​让​ schema ​被​拒​，​因为​它们​过​不了​ JSON ​投影​。

docs.title: 4. schema ​断言​：​迭代​走查​整个​树
docs.text:
/** Validate object-only fields after its property schemas have been visited. */
function checkObjectSchemaTail(node, path, properties, violations): void {
  const hasRequired = Object.hasOwn(node, 'required')
  ...
  if (hasRequired) {
    if (!isPlainJsonArray(required) || required.some(entry => typeof entry !== 'string')) {
      violations.push(`${path}.required must be an array of strings`)
    } else {
      const declared = isJsonSchemaRecord(properties) ? properties : {}
      for (const key of required as string[]) {
        if (!Object.hasOwn(declared, key)) violations.push(`${path}.required names "${key}" which is not in properties`)
      }
    }
  }
  if (Object.hasOwn(node, 'additionalProperties') && typeof node.additionalProperties !== 'boolean') {
    violations.push(`${path}.additionalProperties must be a boolean`)
  }
}

/** Collect every violation for one raw schema tree without using the JavaScript call stack. */
function checkSchemaNode(root: unknown, rootPath: string, violations: string[], seen: Set<object>): void {
  const tasks: SchemaWalkTask[] = [{ kind: 'enter', node: root, path: rootPath }]
  for (let task = tasks.pop(); task !== undefined; task = tasks.pop()) {
    ...
    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
      if (CONSTRAINT_KEYWORDS.has(key)) continue
      if (ANNOTATION_KEYWORDS.has(key)) { ...check lossless JSON...; continue }
      violations.push(`${path}.${key} is not a supported keyword (subset: type/oneOf/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const + annotations)`)
    }
    ...
    if (hasType && hasOneOf) {
      violations.push(`${path} cannot declare both type and oneOf`); continue
    }
    if (!hasType && !hasOneOf) {
      for (const key of ONE_OF_SIBLING_KEYWORDS) {
        if (Object.hasOwn(node, key)) violations.push(`${path}.${key} requires type or oneOf`)
      }
      continue
    }

​检查​器​与​编译器​（schema.ts）​同款​套路​：​显式​任务​栈​代替​递归​、seen ​拒绝​循环​、enter/leave/*-tail ​任务​分离​"​访问​子​节点​前​"​与​"​访问​完后​"​的​检查​（required ​是否​都​出现​在​ properties ​里​需要​先​走​完​ properties ​才能​判​，​所以​是​ object ​的​ tail ​任务​）。​关键​规则​一览​：

  • ​未知​关键词​ = ​违规​（​错误​消息​里​直接​列出​子集​词表​）；
  • ​注解​键​的​值​必须​是​无损​ JSON（getter ​抛错​也​判​违规​）；
  • type ​数组​（JSON Schema ​的​ type: ['string','null']）​明确​不​支持​，​报错​文案​单独​点名​；
  • ​关键词​与​ type ​的​归属​错位​（​如​ items ​写​在​ string ​节点​上​、properties ​写​在​ array ​上​）​逐个​报​；
  • oneOf ​旁边​不许​放​ properties/enum ​等​兄弟​关键词​（​子集​没有​定义​它们​的​组合​语义​）；
  • ​标量​节点​：enum ​必须​非空​、​每​项​类型​匹配​；const ​类型​匹配​，​且​与​ enum ​同用​时​必须​是​ enum ​的​成员​。

​两个​公开​断言​：

export function assertSupportedJsonSchema(schema: unknown): asserts schema is JsonSchemaNode {
  const violations: string[] = []
  checkSchemaNode(schema, 'schema', violations, new Set())
  if (violations.length > 0) throw new JsonSchemaError(violations)
}

export function assertObjectJsonSchema(schema: unknown): asserts schema is ObjectJsonSchema {
  ...
  if (violations.length === 0
    && (!isJsonSchemaRecord(schema) || !Object.hasOwn(schema, 'type') || schema.type !== 'object')) {
    violations.push('schema.type must be "object" (structured output is object-rooted)')
  }
  ...
}

​后者​是子​代理​/​工作​流​结构化​输出​的​消费​级​约束​：​共享​词表​允许​任意​ JSON ​根​，​但​要求​对象​根​的​消费者​自己​加​ assertObjectJsonSchema —— ​子集​不​做​不必要​的​收紧​。

docs.title: 5. ​值​校验​：​显式​帧​、​全​容错​、exact-one oneOf
docs.text:
/** Explicit call frame for stack-safe schema-value validation. */
interface ValueFrame {
  readonly node: JsonSchemaNode
  readonly value: unknown
  readonly path: string
  catches: boolean
  phase: 'start' | 'children'
  kind?: 'oneOf' | 'object' | 'array'
  children: ValueChild[]
  childIndex: number
  violations: string[]
  tailViolations: string[]
  matches: number
}

/** Validate one trusted schema/value pair with explicit frames rather than recursive calls. */
function checkValue(schema: JsonSchemaNode, value: unknown, path: string): string[] {
  const frames: ValueFrame[] = [valueFrame(schema, value, path)]
  ...
  while (frames.length > 0) {
    const frame = frames.at(-1)
    try {
      if (frame.phase === 'children') { ...consume children / finish oneOf & container... }
      ...
      switch (nodeType) {
        case 'object': {
          if (!isPlainJsonRecord(frame.value)) { finish([`"${diagnosticPath(frame.path)}" must be an object`]); break }
          const properties = ...
          const violations: string[] = []
          const required = ...
          for (const key of required) {
            if (!Object.hasOwn(frame.value, key) || frame.value[key] === undefined) {
              violations.push(`missing required property "${propertyPath(frame.path, key)}"`)
            }
          }
          ...
          if (Object.hasOwn(frame.node, 'additionalProperties') && frame.node.additionalProperties === false) {
            for (const key of Object.keys(frame.value)) {
              if (!Object.hasOwn(properties, key)) {
                tailViolations.push(`"${propertyPath(frame.path, key)}" is not a declared property (additionalProperties: false)`)
              }
            }
          }
          ...
        }
        ...
      }
    } catch (error) {
      let failed = frames.pop()
      while (failed !== undefined && !failed.catches) failed = frames.pop()
      if (failed === undefined) throw error
      receive(losslessValueViolation(failed.path))
    }
  }

​设计​要点​：

  • ​显式​帧​代替​递归​：​深层​嵌套​值​不会​栈​溢出​；matches ​计数器​实现​ exact-one ​语义​ —— oneOf ​的​子​分支​全部​试​完后​，​恰好​ 1 ​个​匹配​才​算​过​，​否则​报​ must match exactly one oneOf branch (matched N)。
  • ​对象​值里​显式​ undefined ​的​属性​按​缺失​处理​（value[key] === undefined ​与​ !Object.hasOwn ​同判​）—— ​对齐​ JSON ​的​语义​（JSON ​里​没有​ undefined）。
